description_html:
Commercial Account Executive (DACH/Nordics/CEE)

Location: London, UK

About AppViewX:

AppViewX is trusted by the world's leading organizations to reduce risk, ensure compliance, and increase visibility through automated certificate lifecycle management. At AppViewX, you will get to work with our AVX platform, which is the industry's most advanced and fastest growing cloud-native Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. The AVX Platform allows customers to realize immediate value from complete certificate lifecycle management, enterprise-wide Kubernetes TLS automation, scalable PKI-as-a-Service, secure code signing, easy Microsoft CA migration, IoT security, SSH and key management, and PQC-forward controls in even the most complex multi-cloud, hybrid, and edge environments.

Values

Our values define how we work, make decisions, and deliver for our customers and each other. Some reflect strengths deeply engrained in how we work. Others represent the standards we are committed to building together. 

  • We Do What We Say: We own our commitments, communicate honestly about progress, and measure success by results, not activity. 
  • We Are Trusted Experts: We continuously build our expertise, offer candid guidance, and focus on the outcomes our customers and colleagues need. 
  • We Raise the Bar: We stay curious, challenge the status quo, take smart risks, and turn better ideas into meaningful results. 
  • We Win Together: We share information, debate openly, commit together, and recognize that our success is connected to the success of our customers and teammates. 

If these values reflect how you want to work and contribute, you will find an opportunity to make a meaningful impact at AppViewX. 

Role Overview

The Commercial Sales Executive is responsible for driving revenue growth, identifying new market opportunities, and managing the entire sales cycle for our products/services across designated territories. This role requires a highly motivated, results-orientated professional with a deep understanding of international business and complex commercial negotiations. The successful candidate will be a self-starter who can operate independently in diverse, fast-paced international markets.

Key Responsibilities

Sales and Business Development

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to achieve and exceed sales targets and expand the company's customer base.
  • Identify and qualify new commercial opportunities through market research, networking, and cold outreach in various international markets.
  • Manage the end-to-end sales process, including prospecting, presentation, proposal generation, negotiation, and contract closure with customers, distributors, and partners.
  • Focus on generating significant pipeline and growth. 

Market and Customer Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships, acting as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for clients.
  • Gather market intelligence on industry trends, competitor activities, and regulatory changes to inform product development and sales strategy.
  • Represent the company at industry events and conferences.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to localize sales materials and campaigns.

Sales Operations and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date sales forecasts and activity reports using the company's CRM system.
  • Prepare and deliver quarterly business reviews to senior management, outlining regional performance, challenges, and future strategy.
  • Ensure compliance with all international trade regulations and company policies.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of progressive commercial sales experience
  • Demonstrated ability to close complex, high-value commercial deals in a diverse geographical territory.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in German and English.
  • Willingness to travel internationally frequently (up to 50% of the time).

Preferred

  • Experience with a global distribution network or channel partner model.
  • Proven track record of managing and expanding sales into new, emerging markets.

Travel Requirements

  • Travelling to customers, partners and events as and when required.

description_html:
Soho, London

Hybrid working: 3 days in the office Tues - Thurs

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Team, taking a leading role in building the complex, scalable systems that power our data strategy. You will lead architectural discussions, own the design of business-critical data solutions and deliver high-quality systems that bring millions of fans closer to the sports they love. This is a fantastic opportunity to lead the optimisation of our data platforms for real-time AI/ML workloads, mentor engineers and make a significant impact on our business. The Senior Data Engineer leads technical initiatives, maintains data integrity and performance, and works across teams to translate complex business requirements into effective data solutions. The role also uses automation and artificial intelligence to improve efficiency, decision-making and productivity across the organisation.

At LiveScore Group, we're the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We're proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan's passion for sport driving us to the top.

We don't just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it's our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition. As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you're good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users.

We know that job descriptions can sometimes seem daunting, and you might not feel you tick every box. But, if you're passionate about the role and have relevant experience, we want to hear from you! 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead the design and delivery of robust data pipelines using GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub and Cloud Storage. This includes integrating data from various sources, ensuring data quality and enabling real-time processing capabilities.
  • Own the design of data models and databases that support business analytics and intelligence, using dimensional data-modelling principles. Select and use GCP database technologies such as Bigtable, Spanner or Firestore to optimise performance and scalability.
  • Lead the automation of data workflows and optimisation of data storage and processing costs within GCP. Use tools such as Cloud Composer for orchestration and establish best practices in performance tuning.
  • Ensure data security by implementing GCP security practices. Manage access controls, comply with data-governance policies and safeguard sensitive information.
  • Work closely with data engineers, business analysts and IT teams to define data requirements and deliver comprehensive data solutions. Provide technical leadership and guidance to team members.
  • Evaluate new GCP features and data-engineering technologies, setting technical direction where they can enhance data infrastructure or enable new data products.
  • Lead the resolution of critical pipeline failures and data-quality incidents, performing fault analysis and ensuring that preventative improvements are implemented.
  • Lead critical system-design and architectural decisions for scalable batch and real-time workloads.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to translate complex or ambiguous business needs into effective and innovative data solutions.
  • Mentor engineers, review technical designs and foster a culture of continuous learning and engineering excellence.
  • Own improvements to the reliability, performance and cost-effectiveness of data systems.
  • Lead the design and maintenance of robust, secure integrations with core internal systems and critical third-party platforms.
  • Define appropriate monitoring and alerting standards to ensure high system reliability and minimal downtime.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience 

  • Significant experience in data engineering or data warehousing with large-scale, complex datasets.
  • Advanced SQL and Python skills, with experience using AI-assisted development tools appropriately.
  • Strong knowledge of data-modelling techniques.
  • Deep experience with cloud data services and technologies, ideally within the GCP ecosystem, such as Dataflow, Pub/Sub, BigQuery or Vertex AI.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing robust ELT pipelines, including real-time and large-scale batch processing.
  • Proven ability to deploy and maintain data infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code principles and tools such as Terraform.
  • Experience with Airflow environment management and Docker.
  • Experience contributing to an AI roadmap and evaluating AI tooling, including coding agents, for use within the development lifecycle.
  • The ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrable experience applying data-governance, privacy and security best practices in a regulated environment.
  • A proactive and curious approach, with the ability to anticipate and resolve system inefficiencies.
  • The ability to lead cross-functional technical work and translate complex or ambiguous requirements into robust data solutions.
  • A track record of taking end-to-end ownership for the quality, reliability and performance of business-critical data solutions.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical standards across a team.

What can we offer? 

  • Company Performance Bonus
  • Flexible Working Agreements where applicable
  • Private Healthcare Scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance
  • Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental & Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. Paternity leave: up to 4 weeks at full pay
  • Subsidised Gym Membership
  • Annual Travel Card Loan & Ride to Work Scheme
  • Life Assurance (x3 salary)
  • Contributory Pension Plan
  • Virgin Family: Giving you access to exclusive Virgin offers and experiences
  • Thursday drinks in the office and regular socials

description_html:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is where the world's leading enterprises orchestrate AI-powered work. Our vision is to expand human capacity through superintelligence. And we're proving it's possible – through powerful, trustworthy AI that unites IT and business teams together to unlock enterprise-wide transformation. With WRITER's end-to-end platform, hundreds of companies like Mars, Marriott, Uber, and Vanguard are building and deploying AI agents that are grounded in their company's data and fueled by WRITER's enterprise-grade LLMs. Valued at $1.9B and backed by industry-leading investors including Premji Invest, Radical Ventures, and ICONIQ Growth, WRITER is rapidly cementing its position as the leader in enterprise generative AI.

Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI.

📐 About this role

This is a chance to help shape the next chapter of WRITER's product at a moment when generative AI is redefining how work gets done. As senior staff product manager, you'll report directly to Wil Pong, VP of Product, and operate as a force-multiplier across the product organization — setting direction where it's unclear, aligning stakeholders, and making sure our most critical initiatives ship with excellence.

You'll own ambiguous, high-impact problem spaces that span multiple product areas and teams, and you'll be equal parts strategist and operator. One moment you're shaping a multi-quarter roadmap; the next you're rolling up your sleeves to unblock execution. We're looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer empathy, technical depth, and business judgment — and who is energized by turning complex, evolving AI capabilities into products customers love.

🦸🏻‍♀️ Your responsibilities

  • Drive high-impact product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and problem definition through launch, adoption, and iteration across areas that span multiple squads and surfaces

  • Shape product strategy and roadmap in partnership with the VP of Product and product leadership, translating company-level goals into clear, sequenced, ambitious bets

  • Spend time with enterprise buyers, end users, and prospects to uncover unmet needs, validate problem-solution fit, and champion the customer voice in every decision

  • Partner closely with engineering and design to define requirements, navigate technical tradeoffs, and build the right things in the right order, bringing real fluency to conversations about LLMs, agents, platform architecture, and data

  • Align cross-functional stakeholders across go-to-market, sales, marketing, customer success, and executive leadership, communicating strategy and tradeoffs with crisp, audience-appropriate narrative

  • Define and own success metrics for your areas, using data and qualitative signal to evaluate impact, course-correct, and tell the story of outcomes to leadership

  • Raise the bar on product craft across the org by mentoring and coaching other PMs, modeling best practices, and strengthening a culture built on rigor, customer obsession, and velocity

⭐️ Is this you?

  • 8+ years of product management experience with a track record of owning and shipping complex, high-impact products, ideally in SaaS, platform, infrastructure, or AI/ML-driven environments

  • Senior- or staff-level experience operating autonomously across ambiguous, multi-team problem spaces and influencing outcomes well beyond your immediate team

  • Genuine customer obsession — you instinctively go to the customer, synthesize signal from noise, and design from a deep understanding of real workflows and pain points

  • Technical credibility to engage meaningfully with engineers and researchers on system design, LLM capabilities, data, and architecture, knowing when to go deep and when to defer to the experts

  • A blend of strong strategic thinking and relentless execution — you can set a compelling vision one moment and sweat the details of a release plan the next

  • Exceptional communication that you tailor for any audience, from a frontline engineer to the executive team, driving alignment without relying on org chart authority

  • A mentor's instinct and a builder's drive, with the data-informed, outcome-driven mindset to define success up front and move with the speed this environment demands

Nice to haves

  • Experience building products powered by LLMs, generative AI, or large-scale AI/ML systems

  • Background in enterprise software, developer platforms, or developer-facing products

  • Familiarity with AI governance, guardrails, and the operational considerations of deploying AI in regulated or high-stakes environments

title: Support Operations Analyst
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Aveni
description_html:
Job title: Support Operations Analyst

Reporting to: Support Lead

Location: Remote (UK based)

Are you curious, analytical, and eager to grow in the world of SaaS and AI?

Aveni is an award-winning technology company. We use advanced AI to enable scalable efficiency for financial services companies, combining world-leading Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Model (LLM) expertise with deep financial services domain experience to drive enterprise-wide productivity. Aveni harnesses the power of voice to drive unprecedented efficiency and oversight. We’re using the latest in AI to automate and innovate, empowering businesses to achieve exceptional productivity and compliance outcomes.

We’re looking for a Support Operations Analyst to help us scale how customer support works through AI, automation, knowledge and strong operational processes. A core part of the role will be owning and improving our AI support experience: increasing the proportion of customer requests resolved through AI and self-service, continuously improving the content and workflows that power it, and using conversation data to identify new opportunities for automation. You’ll stay close to customers by providing second-line support when needed, while also improving our knowledge, incident and problem management practices.

About the Role

As a Support Operations Analyst, your primary focus will be making Support more scalable, proactive and effective. You’ll take day-to-day ownership of optimising our AI support agent, Intercom Fin, using performance data and conversation reviews to improve involvement, resolution and deflection. You’ll author and test AI content, tune workflows and routing, identify knowledge and automation gaps, and implement improvements that allow more customers to get the right answer without needing a human response. Alongside this, you’ll own key parts of our customer-facing knowledge and Support operations, help ensure we’re ready for product launches, coordinate customer-impacting incidents and recurring product issues, and provide second-line customer support where human investigation is required.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Second-line Customer Support – Provide hands-on support for customer requests that require human investigation or cannot be resolved through AI or self-service. Troubleshoot issues, communicate clearly with customers and use these conversations to identify opportunities to improve Fin, documentation or product experience.

  • Incident & Problem Management – Act as a Support point of contact during customer-impacting incidents: triage and escalate high-priority issues, coordinate with Engineering, maintain clear stakeholder and customer communications, and contribute recommendations that improve the process. For lower-impact bugs and recurring problems, work with Product and Engineering to maintain visibility and help ensure a healthy level of customer-impacting issues is picked up through sprint planning.

  • Technical Investigation – Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, gather the right evidence and work confidently with Product and Engineering when deeper investigation is required.

  • Product Knowledge – Develop a strong understanding of Aveni’s products to support users effectively and confidently.

  • Launch & Cross-functional Collaboration – Work with Product, Marketing, Training & Enablement and Engineering to ensure Help Centre and Intercom content is accurate, and that customer documentation and Support readiness are in place for new features and product launches.

  • AI Support Optimisation – Take day-to-day ownership of optimising our AI customer support experience. At Aveni we use Intercom Fin, but experience with Zendesk AI or similar platforms is equally relevant. Author, test and continuously improve the content and instructions that power Fin; tune workflows, routing and hand-off paths; review customer conversations to identify new deflection and automation opportunities; and implement improvements that allow more requests to be resolved before reaching the Support team. Own regular reporting on AI involvement, resolution and deflection rates, using the data to identify trends, prioritise experiments and demonstrate the impact of changes.

  • Knowledge Management – Maintain and improve Help Centre content, FAQs and internal Support guidance, ensuring AI and human agents have accurate, useful knowledge to work from. Identify documentation gaps through conversation reviews, support trends and AI performance, and work with Product, Marketing and Training & Enablement to close them.

What We’re Looking For

  • A strong interest in technology, SaaS, and AI.

  • Solid problem-solving skills with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

  • Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in simple terms.

  • Experience in a customer-facing or technical support role, ideally within B2B SaaS, with confidence owning customer issues from first contact through to resolution or escalation.

  • Hands-on experience optimising AI customer support platforms such as Intercom Fin, Zendesk AI or similar. We’re looking for evidence that you have actively improved how an AI agent performs — for example by authoring and testing content, tuning workflows or routing, reviewing conversations for deflection opportunities, and using involvement, resolution or deflection reporting to drive measurable improvements. Direct Fin experience isn't essential; the track record matters more than the platform.

  • Experience maintaining customer-facing knowledge bases or Help Centres and turning support trends into clear, useful documentation.

  • A collaborative team player who is comfortable working both remotely and independently.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in a B2B SaaS or fintech environment, particularly supporting complex or regulated customers.

  • Experience designing or running experiments to improve AI agents, automation or self-service journeys in a customer support environment.

  • Experience using support and AI metrics such as SLA, CSAT, involvement, resolution and escalation trends to identify and prioritise improvements.

  • Experience with incident and problem management practices, including escalation, stakeholder communication, root cause analysis and continuous improvement.

  • Experience working with Product and Engineering during high-priority incidents and managing lower-impact bugs through a backlog or sprint-based development process.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • A collaborative and innovative work environment with career growth opportunities

  • 34 days holiday plus your birthday off (inclusive of bank holidays)

  • Share options – we believe in shared success

  • Skills development – continuous learning is at our core, expect the development to be front and centre of everything you do

  • Remote and flexible working – remote, co-working spaces, or a mix of both

  • Life insurance, income protection and private health care

  • Freebies and discounts at a range of retailers

  • Emotional wellbeing (Employee assistance programme provides access to 24/7 employee counselling and emotional support)

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Pension scheme (employer contribution matched up to 5%)

Join Us in Making a Difference

At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve and creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. If you're passionate about leveraging technology to drive positive change and want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of financial services, we'd love to hear from you. We know that some people are likely to only apply where they meet 100% of requirements, but we’d like to hear from you anyway.

Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI.

Senior Software Engineer

London | Full-time | Hybrid | Shoreditch/Liverpool Street

Create the Future of Travel With Us

Whether it's visiting the people closest to us, starting an exciting adventure, or a career-defining business trip, travel is essential.

Yet we've all experienced the aches and pains of getting to our destination.

More than 4 billion airline passengers rely on technology that hasn't kept up with modern expectations. That's why we're rebuilding the infrastructure that underpins the travel industry - simplifying systems and building tools that will make the future of travel effortless.

We were part of Y Combinator S18's cohort and we're backed by Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures - a fantastic set of investors that has helped build some of the world's largest companies.

Our London team is growing, and we're looking for a Senior Engineer to help shape both the product and the team building it.

Engineering at Duffel

We're building tools to simplify travel distribution, search, and booking through one seamless API. The technical challenge? About the role

As Head of Technical Support, you’ll lead our team of Technical Support Engineers and take responsibility for the quality, effectiveness and development of the function.

You’ll build a team that combines strong technical investigation with clear, thoughtful customer communication. You’ll coach engineers, establish effective ways of working and ensure customers receive dependable support as their integrations grow in complexity and scale.

You’ll stay close to the work: reviewing investigations, helping with significant escalations and understanding where our products or processes create friction. Your impact will come from strengthening the whole team’s ability to resolve problems and turning what we learn from support into lasting improvements.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Partner Engineering, Partner Management and Travel Operations. Technical Support owns day-to-day API questions, troubleshooting and the customer support response to technical incidents. Partner Engineers own strategic technical relationships and solution architecture; Implementation Managers own implementation programmes.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the team. Set clear expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, support career development and address performance issues constructively. Hire and onboard engineers as the team grows.

  • Own support quality. Establish standards for technical investigation, written communication, case ownership and follow-through. Ensure customers understand what is happening, what comes next and who is responsible.

  • Build a dependable support operation. Improve triage, prioritisation, queue management, handovers and escalation paths. Plan staffing and coverage around customer needs and agreed service commitments, with a sustainable workload for the team.

  • Strengthen technical capability. Help engineers investigate API behaviour, interpret logs and request traces, reproduce integration issues and distinguish customer configuration problems from platform or supplier issues.

  • Lead significant customer escalations. Coordinate the support response, establish customer impact and keep communication clear through to resolution. Work with Engineering on diagnosis and recovery, involving Partner Engineering where an issue creates a wider strategic risk.

  • Make collaboration effective. Give Engineering actionable escalation reports with evidence, reproduction steps and impact. Work with Travel Operations on booking and supplier issues, and with implementation teams to ensure new integrations enter support with the context the team needs.

  • Improve the product through support. Identify recurring problems and turn them into clear recommendations for Product and Engineering. Track whether fixes, documentation and product changes actually reduce customer friction.

  • Make support easier to deliver. Develop troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge, customer documentation and useful tooling. Apply automation and AI where they improve accuracy, speed and access to help.

  • Use evidence to guide decisions. Monitor response and resolution performance, ageing work, reopened cases, customer feedback and team capacity. Use that information to prioritise improvements and make clear recommendations about investment.

What we’re looking for

  • Experience managing and developing a technical support or support engineering team serving business customers.

  • A track record of improving both customer outcomes and how a support function operates.

  • Strong technical understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks and integrations, with enough practical depth to guide investigations and earn the trust of engineers.

  • Comfort working with logs, SQL and scripts to investigate problems or improve support workflows.

  • Experience handling consequential customer escalations, including situations where the cause or resolution is initially uncertain.

  • Ability to explain technical issues to developers, business stakeholders and senior leaders.

  • Sound judgement about urgency, customer impact and competing priorities.

  • Evidence of effective hiring, coaching, performance management and delegation.

  • The ability to influence Product, Engineering and commercial teams through clear reasoning and useful evidence.

  • Comfort building and improving a function in a growing company, while remaining involved in its day-to-day work.

Experience that would be useful

  • Supporting an API platform, developer product or infrastructure business.

  • Working with enterprise customers running important production integrations.

  • Leading support across different time zones.

  • Improving support tooling, knowledge management, self-service or automation.

  • Experience in travel technology, payments or another industry with complex external dependencies.

You don’t need to have worked in travel or held this exact title. We’re interested in the teams you’ve developed, the problems you’ve solved and the judgement you bring.

What success looks like

During your first six months:

  • Engineers have clear expectations, regular coaching and practical development plans.

  • Customer issues have clear ownership, appropriate prioritisation and dependable communication.

  • You have established a trustworthy baseline for support performance and delivered measurable improvements in the most important areas.

  • Escalations reach the right teams with better evidence and fewer unnecessary handovers.

  • Recurring problems are being addressed through product changes, documentation or tooling.

  • Duffel has a clear plan for the support capacity and capabilities needed as the business grows.

Why Join Duffel?

We’re a growth-focused team that values open communication, diverse perspectives, and true ownership. We want you to feel empowered in your role, which is why every permanent employee becomes a company shareholder.

 

🌍 Live Your Best Life

  • Duffel Travel Allowance: We subsidise your wanderlust.

🛡️ The Essentials, Upgraded

  • Family Leave (maternity, paternity and adoption): Big support for life’s biggest moments, 26 weeks fully paid.

  • Pensions & Loans: Future-proofing and interest-free commuting.

  • Eye Tests: Keeping your vision (and your style) sharp.

We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe that the key to our success is employing a diverse team, that's why recruitment decisions are only based on your experience and skills. We value your ability to problem solve and build amazing things so we welcome applications for everyone - regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

title: Partnerships Manager (South East)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Allica Bank
description_html:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

Finding effective ways of generating new business is critical to our continued growth. One way is through partnerships with third-parties who refer their SME clients to Allica on an ongoing basis based on mutual trust. Our Partnerships Team work with trusted advisors to established SMEs, in particular their Accountants.

As a Partnerships Manager, you will develop and nurture relationships with accounting firms across your region, taking a consultative, B2B sales approach. You’ll own the end-to-end client experience for Business Rewards Account clients - from generating introductions through to onboarding and funding and coordinate with our specialist Relationship Manager team on additional lending needs. The role involves regional travel, in-person meetings and you’ll be supported by our Marketing team in running events.

Principal Accountabilities

• Manage a regional portfolio of accounting firms- covering cold outbound, warm inbound, and active introducers- moving each firm through the pipeline to become a repeat client introducer.

• Build trust and credibility through a consultative approach, positioning Allica as the most recommended bank by accountants.

• Grow Allica’s presence across each firm, including multiple stakeholders, colleagues and offices, through regular regional travel and in-person meetings.

• Introduce the Business Rewards Account and other banking products to accounting firms and their clients, owning the end-to-end onboarding, funding and account usage journey.

• Qualify and introduce clients with lending needs (e.g. commercial mortgages) to the appropriate Relationship Manager.

• Act as the accounting firm’s dedicated point of contact at Allica

• Deliver and continuously improve our Accountants Playbook, ensuring firms are positively onboarded and become active, repeat introducers.

• Run regional activities - lunch and learns, roundtables and various other events

• Equip firms with an effective Partnerships Pack, marketing materials and joint initiatives to support client identification and introduction.

• Maintain accurate portfolio records in the CRM, tracking and reporting on progress to support quality and informed decision-making.

• Manage personal objectives and development plan.

• Collaborate closely across various teams at Allica to ensure a seamless, professional experience for partners and customers.

• Comply with all mandatory policies and operational procedures to maintain internal controls

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Proven track record in B2B sales and account management

  • Strong understanding of SMEs and the role of professional advisors, particularly accountants

  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with a track record of earning trust from partners, customers and colleagues

  • Strong communication and presentation skills for in-person / virtual meetings and events

  • Confident managing a CRM-based portfolio and reporting on pipeline progress

  • Commercially minded, balancing new revenue generation with appropriate consideration of risk and reputation

  • Comfortable working collaboratively with specialist colleagues (e.g. RMs, Marketing) to deliver good outcomes for customers and the business

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

description_html:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Platform Engineering is the centralised team that builds, provisions and runs the infrastructure every other engineering team at Allica depends on. Whether a product serves a business banking customer or a colleague inside the bank, it lands on a platform this team designed. The team owns both halves of that, building the platform and running it, against the availability and resilience standards a regulated bank is held to. Well-architected is the operating standard, not an aspiration: reliability, security, cost and operational excellence are design inputs from the start.

The job is to make the right thing the easy thing, through paved roads, self-service provisioning, sensible defaults, and controls encoded in the platform rather than bolted on afterwards. Every control the platform enforces is one a product team does not have to think about, and one we can evidence on demand. Role Description The Lead Platform Engineer is the senior technical leader for a core domain of Allica's platform. You set its technical direction, you are accountable for how it behaves in production, and you build it yourself.

This is a hands-on role. Expect to spend a real share of your week in infrastructure as code, pipelines and live systems, and the rest setting standards, reviewing designs and making the calls that are too consequential to delegate. Your customers are internal. Product engineering and data engineering choose whether to use what you build, so adoption and the friction you remove are the measures that matter.

Principal Accountabilities

Platform Architecture and Engineering

  • Own the architecture of Allica’s Cloud platform: landing zones, subscriptions and network topology, container runtime, and the integration and resilience patterns that sit on top. Design again Cloud Adoption Framework and Well-Architected Framework as working disciplines. 

  • Build the reusable core: Terraform modules, deployment templates and platform services that let a team stand up production-grade infrastructure without reinventing the security, networking and observability plumbing each time.

    Infrastructure as Code and Automation 

  • Deliver and manage all infrastructure through Terraform and secure CI/CD, so that every change is automated, repeatable, version-controlled, tested, and reversible. Drive manual change and configuration drift towards zero. 

  • Set and evolve engineering standards for the function: code quality, peer review, policy as code and, release management.

    Security, Governance, and Compliance 

  • Embed security, governance, and compliance throughout the platform lifecycle, implementing effective policies, access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, monitoring, and configuration standards. 

  • Collaborate with Allica’s Security, Engineering, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure platforms meet organisational, regulatory, and control requirements, supported by clear documentation and auditable evidence. 

  • Identify and manage architectural risks, security vulnerabilities, control gaps, and technical debt, ensuring remediation actions are prioritised, tracked, and completed.

    Platform Operations and Service Ownership 

  • Own availability, reliability, and run cost for the platform, backed by service objectives, monitoring you can operate from, and tested recovery arrangements.

  • Lead the response to complex incidents, own the root-cause analysis, drive out repeat causes rather than repeat fixes. 

  • Use service data, operational experience, and FinOps practices to continuously improve platform automation, resilience, engineering standards, cost visibility, forecasting, and resource optimisation.

    Team Leadership 

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of platform engineers while remaining personally hands-on in architecture, design reviews, and the hardest technical problems. 

  • Set the technical bar and raise it, through coaching, design review and the example of your own work.

    Personal Attributes & Experience 

  • A strong track record architecting, and running production Azure environments at scale.

  • Fluent in landing zone and subscription design, private networking, containerised compute, API management and resilience patterns across zones and regions.

  • Extensive hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure at scale, infrastructure as code, containerised runtimes, identity and observability. 

  • Has carried production accountability for systems that matter. Comfortable in handling incidents. 

  • Treats developer experience as a product.

  • Talks to engineering teams, watches how they actually work and designs for adoption rather than mandate. 

  • Treats regulatory and security requirements as engineering constraints to design around, not obstacles to route past.

  • Prior regulated or high-assurance experience helps but is not a prerequisite. 

  • Gets adoption by building things engineers want to use and by making a clear case, not by escalation. 

  • Prefers the boring, well-understood solution unless the problem genuinely demands otherwise. Willing to remove things.

    Desirable Experience 

  • Architecture or engineering experience with Google Cloud Platform. 

  • Experience working in complex, regulated, or security-sensitive environments.

  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, container platforms, serverless services, and cloud-native application patterns. 

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD technologies.  Familiarity with FinOps, operational resilience, regulatory compliance, and cloud-control frameworks.  Relevant Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Terraform, security, or architecture certifications.

title: Endear - Product Designer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Eleve Talent
description_html:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

title: Software Engineer, International

description_html:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

The Money Platform, International team builds the infrastructure that powers Ramp's expansion into global markets. We handle international payments, multi-currency operations, and compliance with regional requirements — the foundational platform that enables Ramp to serve customers beyond the US.

 

International expansion is core to Ramp's growth strategy, and this team directly unlocks it. We work at the intersection of greenfield and scale: launching new markets from 0 to 1 while maturing the systems that already run. The platform we build handles cross-border payments, multi-currency accounting, and integrations with international banking rails — giving every other team a reliable foundation to build on.

 

What You'll Do

  • Build payment infrastructure that works across multiple countries, currencies, and regulatory regimes

  • Design multi-currency accounting and reconciliation systems at scale

  • Integrate with international banking systems and payment rails (SEPA, BACS, and SWIFT)

  • Take on both 0-1 work (launching new markets) and 1-N work (scaling existing ones) simultaneously

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with compliance, product, ops, and external partners to navigate complex regional requirements

  • Own problems end-to-end — from architecture to production reliability to partner integrations

 

What You Need

  • 5+ years of backend or platform engineering experience in high-scale production environments

  • Strong systems design skills — comfortable taking ambiguous requirements and building reliable, maintainable solutions

  • Experience working in fast-moving environments with high ambiguity and independent ownership

  • Comfort with distributed systems, performance optimization, and production reliability

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or capital markets (international payment rails, FX, multi-currency ledgers)

  • Familiarity with financial concepts: multi-currency accounting, reconciliation, cross-border compliance

  • Experience integrating with third-party financial APIs or international banking partners

  • Interest in or exposure to international regulatory environments and compliance requirements

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

 

Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice

description_html:
“Every organization advertises work life balance, but what does that really mean? At Absorb work life balance means you get the opportunity to showcase your talent, be celebrated for your accomplishments and enjoy the rewards of those accomplishments either by celebration yourself or celebrating with your friends and family. At Absorb I get to work for leaders who are not afraid for you to be yourself and colleagues who take pride in celebrating each other. You get the opportunity to Absorb a culture that is truly one of a kind and I am sure you can't wait to be a part of it. Come onboard, we are expecting you.” Olu, Account Executive

 

Are you a proven SaaS sales professional who knows how to guide prospects from first conversation to close? Known as a client’s go-to advisor, you build trust fast, care deeply about customer success, and thrive on helping clients cross the finish line.

As an Account Executive at Absorb, you’ll own inbound mid-market opportunities and lead prospects through the full sales cycle. You’ll take that impeccable aptitude for creating and maintaining relationships, your attention to detail and extraordinary communication skills in representing Absorb throughout negotiations and pushing to close contracts.

Lastly, you are not someone who will shy away from a challenge! In this fast-paced, team-oriented role You’ll have a keen aspiration to work with the entire sales operations team to ensure success and drive a greater and stronger business for Absorb and its partnerships.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Contact prospects via phone, email, face-to-face in order to complete sales.

  • Work collaboratively with the support and technology teams to become an expert in Absorb LMS and the overall learning management landscape.

  • Demonstrate Absorb LMS functionality and provide pricing options to prospects.

  • Present Absorb LMS quotes with approval and forwards order forms internally for approval.

  • Assist Accounts Receivable collections if necessary.

  • Maintain and develop existing and new customers through planned individual account support and liaison with internal staff.

  • Use customer and prospect contact activities tools and systems, and update relevant information held in these systems.

  • Monitor and report on market and competitor activities and provide relevant reports and information.

 

What you’ll bring:

  • 3-5 years experience in B2B SaaS/Software sales

  • Track record of over-achieving quotas

  • Strong phone presence and experience of multiple calls and meetings per day

  • Proficient with corporate productivity and web presentation tools

  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills

  • Strong listening and presentation skills

  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively

 

Additional preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Business or Psychology would be considered an asset, but not required

  • HR tech

  • Experience working with Salesforce

 

Technologies we use:

Absorb LMS, Salesforce, SharePoint, Confluence, Zoom

 

Are you ready to become an Absorber?

What we offer:

  • Fully remote-first work with flexible work arrangements 🏡

  • Comprehensive Health and Wellness Benefits including retirement savings programs, eligibility for two different bonus plans, generous time off, comprehensive medical and dental benefits based on your country of location 🧘

  • New Hire Equipment Allowance and monthly Flex Allowance to support your success 📦

  • Endless opportunity for career growth and internal mobility 🌱

  • Employee driven DE&I programs 🫶

 

Who are we?

Absorb Software is the leading global AI-driven learning platform provider, helping organizations unlock the full potential of their workforce. With its innovative Strategic Learning Systems (SLS) approach, Absorb empowers businesses to align learning with strategic goals, driving measurable impact and workforce agility. The Absorb LMS platform delivers personalized, scalable, and engaging learning experiences for employees, customers, and partners worldwide. Trusted by over 3,300 organizations and 34 million users, Absorb is redefining the future of workplace learning through cutting-edge AI, seamless integrations, and an unwavering commitment to innovation. We empower learners to enrich their lives, workplaces and communities.

 

Our values are simple:

  • We achieve exceptional results by genuinely caring about each other and the work we do

  • We’re united, and we grow through our commitment to elevating continual learning!

AI @ Absorb

We believe in the power of AI and technology to make learning accessible to everyone. By exploring new tools and constantly experimenting, we’re redefining what’s possible. We take an AI‑first approach to unlock human potential, drive impact, and scale better outcomes. As the world evolves, Absorb is committed to growing with you. Investing in your skills every step of the way.

We use AI tools to support our recruitment process, such as organizing applications and highlighting potential matches based on role requirements. While these tools help streamline our review, all screening and final hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team. We encourage candidates to apply authentically and not rely solely on AI-generated responses in their applications.

Absorb is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment for all our people. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. title: Head of Security Operations
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Radiant
description_html:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale - powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our security team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

Location: London, UK | Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent | Reports to: Chief Customer Officer

We're looking for a Head of Security Operations to build Radiant's security function from the ground up. This is a founding role where you’ll help to define the strategy, tooling and operating model for security across our data centres, compute platform and network fabric.

You will also represent Radiant's security posture directly to customers and prospects who are evaluating us for their AI workloads. You will work closely with our Commercial, Compliance and Engineering teams, coordinating on shared risk reporting, security testing and audit evidence.

What You'll Do

Security Strategy & Leadership:

  • Build and own Radiant's security strategy from the ground up, including policy, standards and risk posture for customer-facing infrastructure.

  • Develop our security practices, governance, risk and reporting

  • Define the roadmap and maturity targets for the function.

  • Build the hiring plan and business case for the SecOps team as it scales.

Customer-Facing Security & Trust:

  • Contribute to Radiant's Trust Center as the primary resource for customers evaluating our security posture.

  • Lead security input into customer due diligence, RFPs and technical evaluations, particularly for sovereign and regulated deployments.

  • Represent Radiant directly with customers and prospects on security matters as part of the sales and onboarding process.

  • Audit customer deployments for alignment to agreed security specs

Data Centre & Infrastructure Security:

  • Source, deploy and operate security tooling for the Radiant DCs.

  • Lead physical, environmental and infrastructure-layer security across Radiant's data centre sites.

  • Manage site-level risk including access control, surveillance, third-party and vendor access, and environmental controls.

  • Bring hands-on data centre security expertise; this is a core requirement for the role.

Engineering Partnership:

  • Define and own the tools strategy for the SecOps team. Collaborate with CTO and InfoSec teams to build/buy the necessary tooling.

  • Build support across Engineering, Platform and Product for the security practice.

  • Embed security into how Radiant designs and ships infrastructure without slowing delivery.

Governance, Testing & Collaboration:

  • Partner with the VP InfoSec on shared risk reporting, security testing (internal drills, external pentest) and audit evidence gathering.

  • Develop security culture, development and training for the organisation.

  • Maintain a clear division of ownership with the VP InfoSec, with regular collaboration expected across both domains.

Incident Response & Resilience:

  • Own incident response and crisis management when customer-facing infrastructure is affected.

  • Run post-incident reviews and use them to drive resilience improvements.

  • Communicate directly with customers during major incidents when required.

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on data centre security expertise, covering physical, environmental and infrastructure-layer security, gained in large-scale, high-availability environments.

  • Experience building a security function or SOC from the ground up, without an inherited team or toolset.

  • Experience representing security directly to customers and prospects, including at executive level.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills across engineering leadership without relying on formal authority.

  • Experience working alongside a peer GRC/Infosec function with clearly defined but collaborative boundaries.

  • Experience owning incident response and resilience programmes at scale.

Nice to Have

  • Experience securing AI-native, GPU-accelerated or HPC infrastructure specifically.

  • Background in telecom, hyperscale cloud or colocation data centre operators.

  • Familiarity with sovereign or regulated infrastructure security requirements.

  • Experience with customer-facing security assurance processes such as RFPs, due diligence and trust centers.

Why Join Radiant?

  • Build and own a new function at a rapidly scaling AI infrastructure business, with a genuine mandate to shape it.

  • Work directly with Radiant's Customer Office leadership and C-suite, with real influence over how the company secures and sells its platform.

  • Be part of a team whose work protects the infrastructure powering sovereign and enterprise AI deployments globally.

  • Develop your career in a Brookfield backed company with resources, mentorship and genuine growth opportunities.

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer - Platform

description_html:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

Location: UK (occasional office travel) | Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent | Reports to: Engineering Manager

We’re looking for a Principal Infrastructure Engineer in our Platform team to drive the architecture, design, and implementation of our next-generation AI-native cloud platform. You will analyse cutting-edge technologies, design scalable and resilient infrastructure solutions, and lead their implementation across a globally distributed environment. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with solution-focused leadership, you will enable our infrastructure to power HPC and AI/ML workloads, delivering value through innovation and collaboration.

What You'll Do

Infrastructure Design & Virtualisation:

  • Architect, design and implement virtualisation solutions optimised for AI-native workloads, focusing on HPC environments and hypervisor tuning.

  • Design infrastructure that dynamically adjusts to meet customer demands for storage and networking resources, ensuring resilience and scalability.

Bare-Metal and Operating System Management:

  • Lead the lifecycle management of bare-metal hardware, ensuring efficient provisioning, orchestration, and optimisation.

  • Maintain deep expertise in Unix/Linux systems, delivering secure, performant configurations at scale.

Networking and High-Performance Storage:

  • Design and implement high-performance, cloud-native storage and networking solutions for demanding workloads.

  • Apply advanced knowledge of networking protocols (TCP, UDP, DNS, encryption) and software-defined networking (SDN) technologies.

Kubernetes and Cloud-Native Platforms:

  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes clusters across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, leveraging CNIs and service meshes.

  • Architect scalable CI/CD pipelines to automate infrastructure delivery and ensure reliable global operations.

Security and Audit:

  • Kubernetes security hardening (RBAC, PSA/PSP successors, network policies, admission controllers - OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverino)

  • Secrets management and rotation across clusters (Vault/OpenBao, sealed-secrets, external-secrets patterns)

  • Supply chain security — image scanning, signed artifacts (cosign/sigstore), provenance attestation

  • IAM and least-privilege design across bare-metal, cluster, and cloud control planes

Observability and Automation:

  • Build observability pipelines to monitor and troubleshoot global systems, integrating tools for logs,metrics, and tracing.

  • Create automation frameworks to reduce operational toil, streamline deployments, and enhance scalability using tools like Terraform, Ansible, Go, and Python.

Architecture & Solution Design:

  • Analyse emerging technologies and assess their potential fit within our platform, considering scalability, security, and performance.

  • Develop high- and low-level architectural proposals, balancing technical and business requirements.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation of infrastructure solutions.

  • Provide thought leadership on architecture best practices, driving alignment across engineering and product teams.

Collaboration and Leadership:

  • Foster a 'how do we achieve this?' mindset, championing a positive, solution-oriented approach to challenges.

  • Mentor and guide team members in architectural principles, emerging technologies, and best practices.

  • Partner with engineering leaders and stakeholders to align infrastructure projects with broader organisational goals.

What You'll Bring

Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups.

Our Culture

Who we are:

Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U.S., creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500.

How we work:

  • We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company’s and our clients’ most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally.

  • Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission.

  • Passion for Invention: We’re pushing the frontier of what’s possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration.

  • We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships.

About the Role

We are hiring an AI Solutions Consultant to engage, educate, and close prospective customers looking to modernize their software development with AI. You will work directly with engineering leaders, CTOs, and technical teams at mid-market and enterprise companies to drive customer acquisition and revenue growth.

You may already be in a customer-facing technical role, or you may be a software engineer who wants to bring your technical experience into a more commercial, customer-facing career. We’re looking for technically sharp, curious, competitive people who can build relationships, learn quickly, and want to win.

This is a highly competitive, sales-driven role for someone who wants to win deals, build relationships, and help drive revenue. We want technically sharp, high-achieving individuals with a proven history of excelling in competitive environments.

Responsibilities

  • Advise enterprise customers evaluating Blitzy on technical architecture and implementation

  • Lead technical discussions covering software architecture, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, APIs, and developer workflows

  • Run proofs-of-concept and demonstrate measurable business impact

  • Guide customers through integrating Blitzy into their existing development environments

  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams throughout the customer lifecycle

  • Translate customer feedback into product improvements and roadmap insights

  • Build trusted relationships with technical stakeholders and executives

  • Drive post-sale adoption and expansion across teams and products

  • Serve as the technical conduit between Blitzy’s CTO, AI Engineering team, and customer teams

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions consulting, solutions architecture, or technical leadership

  • Strong understanding of enterprise software development and modern engineering practices

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, APIs, DevOps, CI/CD, and micro services

  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both engineers and executives

  • Experience working with enterprise customers or complex technical environments

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to operate in fast-paced environments

  • Experience as an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, or Solutions Architect

  • Experience with AI/ML technologies or AI-driven products

  • Background working with enterprise SaaS or developer tooling

  • Experience helping companies modernize engineering workflows

Salary Range: $90,000 - 200,000 + Uncapped Commission + Equity

title: Founding Account Executive, New Business
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Fyxer
description_html:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months, and quota hit in two of your last three measured periods

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.


The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win

  • The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.

  • The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.

  • The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.

  • Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.

 

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

The basics

  • Remote, US

  • Compensation: $100K base / $200K OTE (plus equity, depending on location)

  • Uncapped with accelerators above 100%. Reports to Alec Kraft, VP of Sales

  • Travel: Occasional for enterprise customers
