title: Endear - Product Designer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Eleve Talent
description_html:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

title: Founding Account Executive, New Business
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Fyxer
description_html:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months, and quota hit in two of your last three measured periods

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.


The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win

  • The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.

  • The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.

  • The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.

  • Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.

 

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

The basics

  • Remote, US

  • Compensation: $100K base / $200K OTE (plus equity, depending on location)

  • Uncapped with accelerators above 100%. Reports to Alec Kraft, VP of Sales

  • Travel: Occasional for enterprise customers

Compensation: $90K – $100K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • $180-200 OTE 50/50 split. Uncapped with accelerators above 100%

title: Sales Associate, Strategic & National
description_html:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Sales Associates are responsible for identifying and generating high-value opportunities for our Account Executives to close. The SDR will become a trusted resource and develop relationships with prospects, acting as the initial point of contact. This role will be primarily focused on researching the Target Accounts in their territory and performing outreach through emails, calls, and LinkedIn.

Previous experience as an SDR is not required, but you should want to foster a long-term career in sales. The SDR role is your foot in the door to the wide, lucrative world of B2B sales. We are looking for individuals with a passion for advancing in their career and consider learning and growing a vital part of their professional development. Top performers in this role are individuals who take extreme ownership over their process and remain diligent in their outreach and follow-up. A winning attitude and perseverance are crucial for success as an SDR.

This role will have some focus on strategic and national accounts, requiring thoughtful account research, multi-threaded prospecting, and the ability to engage complex organizations. The ideal candidate uses AI tools thoughtfully to automate repetitive tasks, improve account research, personalize outreach, and increase the effectiveness of their sales workflow while applying sound judgment and maintaining a high-quality prospect experience.

The Sales Associate team is full of diverse, energetic, passionate, and collaborative folks who are seeking to grow their careers and develop their sales skill set. Our team is often the first interaction between Carrot and a prospective client, so our impact and opportunity is massive. We are looking for someone to hit the ground running and help us continue to evolve and succeed!

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor's Degree
  • At least one year of Sales experience (in any industry/capacity)
  • Experience prospecting into complex, strategic, enterprise, or national accounts
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to automate tasks, improve productivity, conduct research, or enhance sales outreach
  • Ability to think strategically about account prioritization and stakeholder engagement
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills
  • Clear history of diligent process and clear follow-up abilities
  • Experience persevering despite challenges
  • Experience with sales tools (SalesLoft/Outreach, Salesforce, SalesNav, etc.)
  • Independent self-starter who also works well on a team
  • Passionate about providing inclusive coverage to marginalized populations

Nice to Have ⭐

  • 6-9 months of experience as an SDR
  • Professional experience in a client-facing role
  • Professional experience in fertility, reproductive health, healthcare, employee benefits, health plans, or a related industry

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes
  3. Peer Panel Interview— 45 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $65,000-$75,000, plus a variable component. Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

title: Data Center Engineer (in Atlanta, GA)
description_html:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

We are actively seeking an experienced Data Center Engineer for our Infrastructure Reliability team. This person will be responsible for building and installing multiple hardware components that make up the company’s infrastructure, focusing on long-term planning, design, and optimization of the data center environment. This position will be working at our data center in Atlanta, GA, five days per week, along with being on call.

This role includes managing hardware, software, and network connections to ensure the reliability, security, and efficiency of the data center's operations. They handle tasks like installing and configuring equipment, troubleshooting issues, performing maintenance, and contributing to disaster recovery planning. He/she exhibits a deep understanding of data center technologies, strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, and excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Designing and implementing new data center infrastructure, optimizing for performance and scalability, ensuring security, and planning for future growth
  • Build, manage and maintain company’s infrastructure in global data centers
  • Perform equipment installs – compute, network, storage, racks, PDUs, cabling, etc.
  • Closely monitor infrastructure to prevent failures and service degradation
  • Monitor and calculate power usage, power balancing and power availability in each cabinet
  • Ability to collaborate with other engineers and IT professionals to achieve common goals, troubleshooting and resolving issues
  • Communicate and coordinate with remote hands in remote data centers, providing technical direction when needed
  • Maintain asset inventory in DCIM – for both production and lab environments
  • Perform all shipping and receiving duties including RMA activities
  • Maintain impeccable documentation around our datacenter configuration
  • Set standards of excellence for all datacenter operations
  • Performing regular maintenance tasks, such as cleaning, inspecting, and replacing components, to prevent problems and ensure the longevity of the equipment
  • Update and work on tickets and tasks assigned in a timely manner
  • Follow change management process and participate in off hours change windows
  • Provide 24x7 support as needed
  • Participate in on-call rotation, incident response, and root cause analysis for platform reliability issues.
  • Comfortable using command line interfaces
  • Familiarity with Linux and other cli operating systems
  • Familiar with server, storage, internet technologies
  • Ability to lift up to 75 lb.

Requirements:

  • Strong technical knowledge of networking, servers, storage, and virtualization, experience with data center design and implementation, ability to analyze and optimize performance, and project management skills
  • Minimum of 4 years hands on experience with Data Centre technologies – compute, network, storage, cabling, racks, PDUs, etc.
  • Great knowledge and experience with planning cooling, power and space resources Linux/Unix system administration, networking and SAN connectivity skills strongly desired
  • Experience working with vendors (quote-purchase process, RMA processes, support interactions)
  • Coding skills to automate repetitive tasks and gather reporting information
  • Experience supporting 24x7 customer facing production environment
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve hardware problems independently
  • Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Work Location: This role is fully onsite. 5 days a week in office is required.

description_html:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior DevOps Engineer – Storage Platforms to build, automate and operate large-scale Software Defined Storage (SDS) and Kubernetes platforms in a private cloud environment. This role focuses on Storage Engineering with Infrastructure-as-Code and GitOps practices while ensuring scalability, resilience, and performance.

This is a deeply technical role requiring expert-level understanding of Software Defined Storage, Kubernetes and extensive working knowledge on Linux Operating systems. You will also collaborate with platform and SRE teams to maintain secure, performant, and multi-tenant-isolated services that serve high-throughput, mission-critical applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy, automate, and operate large-scale Software Defined Storage architectures across private and public cloud regions within ITIL methodology.
  • Deploy and support enterprise storage platforms (Pure Storage, HPE, NetApp) and SDS solutions (Ceph, Longhorn).
  • Integrate self-service storage workflows for Kubernetes CSI and OpenStack consumers (VM and Baremetal).
  • Implement and manage backup solutions (preferably Rubik).
  • Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code for storage platforms using Ansible, Terraform, Helm and Git, with Python/Bash automation.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure updates, patching, upgrades, testing, and rollback.
  • Implement and improve monitoring, alerting, and observability for storage systems (capacity, latency, IOPS, recovery health) using GitOps and tools such as Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana.
  • Perform deep troubleshooting across storage, Kubernetes, hypervisors, networking, and Linux systems.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, operational procedures, and runbooks
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and root cause analysis.
  • Collaborate globally on change management, documentation, and operational best practices.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience managing enterprise storage and Kubernetes platforms on Linux.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SDS solutions (Ceph, Longhorn) and storage migrations from legacy systems.
  • Expertise with block, file, and object storage, including Fibre Channel (Cisco MDS) and IP-based protocols (NVMe-oF or iSCSI farbics).
  • Expert knowledge of Kubernetes and Linux systems (Ubuntu, RHEL/CentOS).
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) (Ansible, Terraform) for provisioning storage and backup schedules
  • Expertise in backup technologies (preferably Rubik)
  • Strong scripting skills in Python and Bash (Golang (GO) a plus).
  • Experience operating 24x7 mission-critical production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with KVM hypervisors (Suse Harvester, OpenStack).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks
  • Ability to write technical documentation and contribute to community wikis or knowledge bases.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • OpenStack Cinder multi-backend administration.
  • Backup platforms (Rubrik).
  • Understanding of CIS/NIST security and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • ITIL Foundation/advanced certifications in support of ITSM standard methodology.
  • Background in telco, edge cloud, or large enterprise environments.
  • CNCF Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS) or Red Hat specialist in Ceph Storage Administrator (EX125) certifications.
  • Master’s degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience and relevant industry certifications will also be considered.

What You’ll Get

  • A collaborative team that’s deeply invested in infrastructure excellence.
  • Complex technical challenges that require creative, scalable solutions.
  • The opportunity to shape a next-generation private cloud platform-built reliability.
  • Access to the latest tools, frameworks, and upstream project developments.

Skills and Attributes:

  • Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to translate complex, cross-domain requirements into scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure and automation solutions.
  • Collaboration & Teamwork: Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a proven track record of effective collaboration across multidisciplinary teams, including developers, operations, security, and product stakeholders.
  • Mentorship & Leadership: Passionate about knowledge-sharing and mentorship, with experience guiding junior engineers and fostering a team culture of continuous learning, innovation, and technical excellence in cloud engineering and DevOps practices.

description_html:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

HackerOne Values

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

Senior Manager, Talent Strategy and HR Business Partnerships

Location: HackerOne US Hubs:

Washington, DC; Boston, MA; Seattle, WA; San Francisco Bay; or Austin, TX


Position Summary

At HackerOne, our people strategy is business strategy. The Talent Strategy team partners with leaders across the company to ensure we have the talent, leadership capability, and scalable people practices needed to achieve our goals while creating an exceptional experience for Hackeronies.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Talent Strategy to lead strategic talent partnership across key business functions while helping transform how the Talent Strategy team operates. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of Talent Strategy Partners, strengthen our partnership model, and build more scalable practices across workforce planning, performance, talent management, manager enablement, and change support.

You will partner with senior leaders to translate business priorities into practical talent plans, clearer performance expectations, stronger workforce decisions, and leadership support that helps teams execute through change. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can operate in ambiguity, coach leaders through transformation, improve how a team works, and connect talent strategy directly to business outcomes.

At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Washington, Austin, San Francisco, Seattle or Boston. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a team of Talent Strategy Partners, creating scalable practices that strengthen leadership effectiveness, organizational health, and talent outcomes across the business through Multiply Your Impact.

  • Partner with senior leaders to translate business priorities into talent strategies, workforce plans, organizational design recommendations, and leadership development initiatives while demonstrating Own the Outcome for talent results.

  • Guide leaders through organizational change, helping teams adapt with clarity and confidence while embedding Change Agility into how the business operates.

  • Drive company-wide talent programs including performance management, succession planning, talent reviews, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.

  • Use Data-Driven Decision Making to identify workforce trends, assess organizational health, measure talent outcomes, and influence business decisions with evidence-based recommendations.

  • Apply First Principles Problem Solving to complex people and organizational challenges, simplifying processes and designing scalable solutions that improve employee and manager experiences.

  • Champion an AI First approach across Talent Strategy by identifying opportunities to improve decision quality, increase efficiency, and scale People Team impact through responsible AI adoption.

  • Collaborate closely with Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Total Rewards, HRIS, and executive stakeholders to ensure consistent execution of talent priorities across the employee lifecycle.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of progressive HR, People Partner, Talent Strategy, Leadership Development, Organizational Development, or related experience.

  • 3+ years of people leadership experience managing HR, Talent Strategy, or People Business Partner teams.

  • Experience partnering with senior leaders on organizational design, workforce planning, change management, and talent management initiatives.

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage workforce data, business metrics, and organizational insights to influence strategic decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple business functions within a high-growth SaaS or technology company.

  • Experience leading large-scale organizational change and talent transformation initiatives.

  • Experience implementing AI-enabled tools and workflows within HR or People functions.

  • Experience supporting globally distributed teams across multiple regions and cultures.

#LI-IJH1

Job Benefits:

  • Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance*

  • Equity stock options

  • Retirement plans

  • Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO

  • Paid maternity and parental leave

  • Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)

  • Employee Assistance Program

*Eligibility may differ by country

Visa/work permit sponsorship is not available.

Employment at HackerOne is contingent on a background check.

This policy applies to all HackerOne employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. HackerOne makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

Position Summary

HackerOne is redefining how the world’s leading organizations manage cyber risk — and AI is at the center of that transformation. As Senior Manager, AI Engineering, you will own two of the most strategically important product surfaces in our platform:

  • AI-Native Intelligence Dashboard — Transform our executive and analytical dashboard into an AI-first experience that helps customers derive maximum value from their HackerOne engagement. Think proactive risk insights, natural language querying, automated remediation prioritization, and measurable reduction in Mean Time to Remediate (MTTR).

  • Payments & Monetization — Lead the team responsible for researcher payments and consumption-based billing, ensuring security researchers are paid reliably and HackerOne’s contract monetization engine runs cleanly at scale.

You will lead the team of senior engineers, set technical direction, and ship AI-powered capabilities that customers can see, feel, and measure. This is a high-autonomy role with real product ownership and direct customer impact.

Reflecting our Flexible Work philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Washington DC, Boston, or Austin, with in-office presence typically on Thursdays.

At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of the listed locations above. What You Will Do

Success in this role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne.

  • Multiply Your Impact by leading, mentoring, and developing Engineering Managers and senior engineers, building scalable systems and practices that allow teams to deliver AI-powered solutions consistently and independently

  • Own the Outcome for execution across multiple AI engineering teams, ensuring delivery commitments are met, dependencies are actively managed, and teams are accountable for customer-visible impact

  • Drive an AI First approach to engineering by embedding AI-powered workflows, agentic systems, and responsible AI practices into how teams design, build, and operate products

  • Practice Change Agility by guiding teams through evolving AI technologies, shifting priorities, and emerging security threats while maintaining clarity, momentum, and team health

  • Leverage Data-Driven Decision Making to assess system performance, model quality, delivery outcomes, and operational health, using evidence to inform priorities and improvements

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, Data, Security Research, and other Engineering leaders to align AI engineering efforts with company strategy and customer needs

title: CSM II
description_html:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is looking for a Customer Success Manager II to own the health, adoption, retention, and growth of a book of Small Business (SMB) accounts. Reporting to a Manager of Customer Success, you will serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for HR benefits leaders across your portfolio, helping them communicate the value of the Carrot benefit, respond to their needs, and ensure Carrot remains a celebrated part of their benefits offering.

Your day-to-day will center on proactive account management: running regular check-ins and business reviews, monitoring success metrics like CSAT, utilization, and member engagement, and surfacing risks before they become churn drivers. You will support renewals across your book and identify expansion opportunities that contribute to ACV growth. This is an ideal role for a customer-centric CS professional who executes established playbooks with consistency and quality while building the foundation for growth into more complex account work at Carrot.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Own the health, adoption, retention, and growth of a book of SMB accounts, serving as the primary point of contact for HR benefits leaders
  • Conduct regular check-ins and business reviews to align on goals, track program performance, and course-correct proactively
  • Monitor and act on success metrics including CSAT, utilization, and member engagement to identify risks and address churn drivers early
  • Support the renewal cycle across your book, partnering with Customer Success leadership to drive on-time close and strong retention outcomes
  • Identify and pursue expansion and upsell opportunities within your book, contributing to ACV growth
  • Partner with internal teams, including Product, Implementation, Member Support, and Operations, to ensure customers realize full value from their Carrot partnership
  • Maintain accurate account records and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce
  • Execute established SMB playbooks with consistency and surface feedback that helps the team improve and scale

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Built trusted relationships across your SMB book, reflected in strong CSAT scores and retention outcomes
  • Consistently met retention, engagement, and growth targets for your portfolio
  • Established a proactive account management rhythm, with risks surfaced and addressed before they escalate
  • Contributed expansion opportunities that grew ACV across your book
  • Earned a reputation as a reliable, collaborative teammate who operates established playbooks with quality and consistency

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or customer support in a high-growth technology environment
  • A track record of managing a book of business with strong retention and customer satisfaction outcomes
  • Comfort presenting to HR benefits leaders, with a clear, empathetic communication style that balances customer needs against internal priorities
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or another CRM
  • Strong organizational skills and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset
  • Enthusiasm for Carrot’s mission and eagerness to be part of a collaborative, friendly, and dynamic team

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Familiarity with Carrot’s buyers (HR benefits leaders) and the employee benefits landscape
  • Prior experience supporting renewal or expansion conversations with existing customers
  • Experience with tools beyond Salesforce, such as Gong, Airtable, or BI/reporting tools
  • Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast-scaling environment; organized, diligent, and self-motivated

Why This Role Matters

SMB customers make up a large share of Carrot’s customer base, and the CSM II role is the front line of how those customers experience Carrot. Strong account management at this level directly protects retention, drives member engagement, and creates the expansion pipeline that fuels segment growth.

Every renewed account and every engaged member means more people accessing fertility and family-building care through their benefits. This role turns Carrot’s mission into a lived experience for thousands of members, one well-managed account at a time.

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes
  3. Presentation Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes
  5. Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $70,000.00 $82,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

title: Enterprise Account Director
description_html:
Job Title: Enterprise Account Director

Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our Enterprise Account Directors are pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing sales team and will be our boots-on-the-ground solution to building personal relationships and making our customers successful. We believe that the most successful sellers have a passionate and supportive team behind them.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for:

  • Full-Cycle Account Ownership: Acting as the primary commercial lead for a portfolio of large-scale enterprise accounts, driving full-cycle accountability for high-value renewals, expansion opportunities, and complex cross-sell transactions.
  • Driving Net-New Revenue: Relentlessly identifying and closing net-new revenue within your install base. You will navigate complex organizational structures to displace incumbents and introduce new product lines, maximizing Total Contract Value.
  • Strategic Account Planning: Architecting and implementing sophisticated account success plans that align our technology's value proposition with specific business units and their long-term alignment between their business goals and our solutions.
  • Proactive Retention Management: Monitoring account health and usage patterns to identify potential churn risks early, implementing "save" strategies to protect existing recurring revenue.
  • Executive Relationship Building: Building a "multi-threaded" network of stakeholders. You will move beyond the day-to-day users to secure buy-in from VP and C-level executives, establishing yourself as a credible business partner.
  • Executive Business Reviews (EBRs): Leading regular business reviews with key stakeholders to demonstrate realized ROI, socialize new product capabilities, and ensure the platform remains indispensable to the client's evolving tech stack.
  • Forecasting & Pipeline Accuracy: Maintaining a rigorous, data-driven sales process. You will provide leadership with high-confidence forecasts for both expansion bookings and retention.
  • Market & Competitive Intelligence: Staying up to date of industry trends and competitor movements to effectively position our value proposition against market alternatives.
  • Orchestrating Internal Resources: Leading a cross-functional team (Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, and Product) to ensure your accounts receive a cohesive experience, effectively acting as the one accountable for all customer-facing initiatives.
  • Voice of the Customer (VoC) Advocacy: Synthesizing client feedback and market friction points to provide actionable insights to the Product and Engineering teams, influencing the roadmap to better serve the "Install Base" and drive future expansion.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to sell an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking a results-oriented, motivated, and strategic Enterprise Account Director. You are a growth-minded advocate who is laser-focused on deepening and expanding relationships within our existing customer base. You don't just manage accounts; you hunt for untapped potential, identifying new use cases and scaling our footprint across organizations.

Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us become an anchor technology company by securing high-value renewals and winning expansion deals that propel you past your quota.

If you're passionate about sales technology, obsessed with delivering a world-class customer experience, and thrive in a fast-paced, hyper-growth startup environment, then this is the career path for you!

THE TEAM:

Our Salesloft Enterprise Team is comprised of motivated sales professionals.

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.

The Enterprise Account Director team consists of results-oriented SaaS sales professionals with a strong desire to win. The ADs on our team share a few common traits: they are self-motivated, ambitious, and passionate about evangelizing the future of sales innovation.

THE SKILL SET:

  • 7+ years of proven relationship building and closing experience in a sales environment.
  • Experience establishing strategic C-level relationships
  • Ability to run a full sales lifecycle, start to finish, within the Enterprise segment
  • Experience executing detailed product presentations and web demonstrations of our software capabilities to C-level executives, directors, and sales managers
  • Adept at identifying and utilizing internal resources (Sales Engineers, Customer Success, Support etc.) to build Salesloft brand awareness, assist in sales cycles, and close deals.
  • Collaborative mentality by prioritizing 'we' and not focusing on 'me.'
  • Superb listening skills; you must understand objections and defeat them by turning sceptics into ecstatic new customers
  • High level of empathy - it's important for our AD's to be a good person to peers and prospects.
  • Experience managing, expanding, and renewing customer relationships.
  • Consistent overachievement of quota and revenue goals.
  • Proven ability to make strong connections and overcome rejection to achieve results.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct compelling on-site and virtual presentations to C-Level executives.

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

title: Sales Associate
description_html:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Sales Associates are responsible for identifying and generating high-value opportunities for our Account Executives to close. The SDR will become a trusted resource and develop relationships with prospects, acting as the initial point of contact. This role will be primarily focused on researching the Target Accounts in their territory and performing outreach through emails, calls, and LinkedIn.

Previous experience as an SDR is not required, but you should want to foster a long-term career in sales. The SDR role is your foot in the door to the wide, lucrative world of B2B sales. We are looking for individuals with a passion for advancing in their career and consider learning and growing a vital part of their professional development. Top performers in this role are individuals who take extreme ownership over their process and remain diligent in their outreach and follow-up. A winning attitude and perseverance are crucial for success as an SDR.

The Sales Associate team is full of diverse, energetic, passionate, and collaborative folks who are seeking to grow their careers and develop their sales skill set. Our team is often the first interaction between Carrot and a prospective client, so our impact and opportunity is massive. We are looking for someone to hit the ground running and help us continue to evolve and succeed!

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor's Degree
  • At least one year of Sales experience (in any industry/capacity)
  • Experience prospecting into complex, strategic, enterprise, or national accounts
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to automate tasks, improve productivity, conduct research, or enhance sales outreach
  • Ability to think strategically about account prioritization and stakeholder engagement
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills
  • Clear history of diligent process and clear follow-up abilities
  • Experience persevering despite challenges
  • Experience with sales tools (SalesLoft/Outreach, Salesforce, SalesNav, etc.)
  • Independent self-starter who also works well on a team
  • Passionate about providing inclusive coverage to marginalized populations

Nice to Have ⭐

  • 6-9 months of experience as an SDR
  • Professional experience in a client-facing role
  • Professional experience in fertility, reproductive health, healthcare, employee benefits, health plans, or a related industry

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes
  3. Peer Panel Interview— 45 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $55,000-$65,000, plus a variable component. Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

title: Solutions Engineer (Pre-Sales) France
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Aikido Security
description_html:
🌍 We’re making security suck less for developers.

Security tools haven’t kept up with how software is built today. They interrupt teams, slow releases, and turn security into a bottleneck instead of a capability. We built Aikido to change that. Aikido builds developer-first security products that reduce real risk without getting in the way of shipping software. We focus on what actually matters and automate the rest.

We’re taking on legacy security tools teams have been stuck with, and we’re winning. If you want to help us take market share and build products developers actually enjoy using, you’re in the right place.

Founded in 2022 by third-time founders, Aikido has $85M in the bank and a long runway ahead. We’re building toward self-securing software. Join an all-star team. Take real ownership. Push boundaries. Build things that matter.

As a Solution Engineer at Aikido, you’ll play a key role in the sales process, partnering closely with Account Executives to help prospects understand, evaluate, and successfully adopt our platform. You’ll act as the technical counterpart in deals, running demos, guiding evaluations, and ensuring customers clearly see the value of Aikido. This role is heavily focused on pre-sales, helping drive deals forward by translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for developers, security teams, and technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to drive the pre-sales process, leading technical demos and product walkthroughs tailored to customer use cases

  • Run proofs-of-concept (POCs) and guide prospects through technical evaluations

  • Help prospects understand how Aikido fits into their code → cloud → runtime environments

  • Debug and troubleshoot technical questions during the sales process

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to developers, security teams, and engineering leaders

  • Collaborate with product and engineering to relay customer feedback and improve the platform


  • 3–7+ years in a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Pre-Sales role

  • Strong technical foundation (cloud, DevOps, security, or developer tooling) and experience running demos, POCs, and technical evaluations

  • Comfortable engaging with both technical and business stakeholders

  • Ability to explain complex concepts in a simple, clear way

  • Hands-on mindset, able to troubleshoot and dig into technical workflows

  • Strong communication skills and a proactive, ownership-driven approach

  • Lives in Paris and speak French native

What you can expect

  • Short decision lines. Big ownership. Shape the projects that matter and ship fast.

  • Grow as fast as we do. Take on more, own more, and carve out your own path.

  • Top-tier tech pay and equity.

  • High trust, strong values, zero corporate BS.

  • Flexibility in working hours.

  • A company that sticks to its values in an open and informal atmosphere.

We hire for talent, drive, and potential. Everything else is noise.

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Journalismus & SEO-Marketing | Auto-Fan mit Schreibtalent gesucht!
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at myAutoAbo
description_html:
Du schreibst Texte, die man gern liest, dein Herz schlägt fürs Auto und du weißt, wie Content bei Google UND bei echten Menschen ankommt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir sind myAutoAbo, ein junges, schnell wachsendes Unternehmen rund ums Auto-Abo. Bei uns schreibst du nicht für den Papierkorb: Deine Artikel, Ratgeber und Fahrzeug-Storys erreichen echte Leser, ranken bei Google und laufen über unsere Social-Media-Kanäle. Beim Schreiben unterstützt dich KI, wir brauchen dich vor allem wegen deines Judgements: Welche Themen lohnen sich, welcher Winkel zieht, und wie klingt ein Text wirklich gut?

So arbeiten wir ⚡

AI-first: Wir erledigen so viel wie möglich mit KI und optimieren unsere Zeit radikal. Routine automatisieren wir, damit Raum für die wichtigen Entscheidungen bleibt

  • Hohes Pacing: Wir skalieren schnell, erfinden uns praktisch täglich neu und hinterfragen auch das, was gestern noch funktioniert hat
  • Kleines, dynamisches Team: Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, deine Arbeit geht nicht im Konzern-Getriebe unter, sondern bewegt echte Menschen und trägt zu Entscheidungen in unserer Branche bei

Aufgaben

  • Recherche und Erstellung von redaktionellen Inhalten rund um Autos, Auto-Abos und Mobilität (Ratgeber, Fahrzeugvorstellungen, News etc.)
  • SEO-Optimierung von Texten: Keyword-Recherche, Snippets, interne Verlinkung
  • Content-Planung gemeinsam mit unserem Marketing- und Social-Media-Team
  • Aufbereitung von Themen für verschiedene Kanäle (Website, Newsletter, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)
  • Einsatz von KI-Tools für Recherche, Texterstellung und Optimierung + Aufsetzen eigener Agent-Workflows.
  • Erfolgsmessung: Rankings, Performance und Nutzerverhalten im Blick behalten und daraus lernen

Qualifikation

  • Eingeschriebene/r Student/in in Journalismus, Medien-/Kommunikationswissenschaften, Marketing, Germanistik o.ä.
  • Sehr gutes Sprachgefühl und Spaß am Schreiben, du bringst komplexe Themen verständlich auf den Punkt
  • Du denkst mit, statt nur zu schreiben: Dich interessiert das Big Picture, also warum schreiben wir diesen Text, für wen, und was soll er bewirken?
  • Interesse an Autos und der Mobilität von heute & morgen
  • Gutes Verständnis für Social Media und wie Content dort funktioniert
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit SEO sind ein Plus, kein Muss. Neugier zählt mehr!
  • Du willst AI-first arbeiten: KI-Tools für Recherche, Text und Optimierung nicht nur nutzen, sondern in eigene Workflows einbauen
  • Lust auf Herausforderungen, Eigeninitiative und die Motivation, ständig dazuzulernen und dich auch mal neu zu erfinden

Du musst nicht jeden Punkt perfekt abhaken, das erwarten wir auch gar nicht. Was wir suchen, sind wissbegierige Leute mit Geschmack, schneller Auffassungsgabe und Lust auf Autos, die gute Laune und eigene Ideen mitbringen. Dafür bekommst du keine 0815-Werkstudentenstelle: Dich erwarten viel Verantwortung, eine steile Lernkurve und Aufstiegschancen, die weit über den „normalen" Werkstudentenjob hinausgehen.

Benefits

  • Speed & Skalierung: Wir wachsen schnell und shippen schnell, deine Texte gehen in Tagen live, nicht in Quartalen
  • Gesundes Fehler-Mindset: Fehler sind menschlich und gehören dazu, so lernen wir am schnellsten. Wichtig ist, Lösungen zu finden, statt den Kopf in den Sand zu stecken.
  • Du optimierst dich selbst mit KI: Du lernst, deine eigene Arbeit mit KI schneller und besser zu machen. Ein Skill, der dir überall weiterhilft
  • Echte Bylines: Deine Texte gehen live und erreichen tausende Leser
  • Intensives Mentoring in SEO, Content-Strategie und KI-gestütztem Arbeiten
  • Abwechslungsreiche Themen, von Fahrzeugtests bis Mobilitätstrends
  • Modernes Büro in Berlin-Kreuzberg mit Barista-Flatrate, frischem Obst und coolen Team-Events
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, egal ob vor Ort, hybrid oder 100% remote (auch außerhalb Deutschlands möglich). Hauptsache ist, dass du motiviert und zuverlässig bist!

Klingt gut? 🚀

Dann schick uns eine kurze Vorstellung von dir, gern mit ein bis zwei Schreibproben (Blog, Uni, Social Media, egal woher). Kein Anschreiben nötig, wir wollen deine Texte lesen, nicht dein KI-generiertes Anschreiben! Bewirb dich einfach direkt hier. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

description_html:
Unternehmen:

Internationales, erfolgreiches Unternehmen aus dem Gesundheitswesen / Medizintechnik mit globaler Aufstellung. In der DACH-Region mit mehreren hundert Mitarbeitenden an zahlreichen Standorten vertreten. Die Position ist am Standort Hamburg angesiedelt, in Vollzeit und unbefristet.

Aufgaben

  • Ganzheitliche Betreuung eines definierten Mitarbeitenden-Kreises

title: Security Engineer Intern
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Swile
description_html:
About the role

Our Security team protects Swile's products, data and engineering platform. We work with a simple principle: when something is recurring, we automate it, and when a security requirement can become code, we write the code.

As a Security Engineer Intern, you will not shadow the team, you will be part of it. You will handle real alerts, run your own audits and own projects end to end, with a dedicated mentor in the team throughout your internship.

What you will do

Detection and response

  • Handle day to day security alerts: triage, investigate, qualify, escalate when needed.
  • Improve what we detect: reduce noise, close detection gaps, propose new signals.
  • Automate the recurring: when an alert or a manual check keeps coming back, script it away. This is where we expect you to leave a mark.

Security audits

  • Run targeted audits, from a few days to a few weeks, on applications, configurations or third party providers.
  • Turn findings into a prioritised remediation plan rather than a list of tickets.

Projects you will own

  • Ad hoc security projects across the engineering platform.
  • Security review and hardening of the tools and integrations we rely on (Dust, third party providers, internal integrations).

Fraud

  • Support fraud investigations: dig, follow the trail, understand how an abuse pattern works and how we could detect it earlier.

What we are looking for

This is an internship, so how you think matters more than what you already know.

  • You learn fast and you are genuinely curious about security.
  • You are a doer: you answer quickly, you close loops, you do not let things sit.
  • You are pragmatic: you calibrate your response to the actual level of urgency and risk, and you know that not everything is a P1.
  • You are open minded and comfortable asking questions across engineering teams.
  • You are comfortable working in English, written and spoken.
  • You have some scripting ability (Python or equivalent) and a basic understanding of web applications, APIs and cloud environments.

Nice to have that would make you stand out

  • Personal projects, CTFs, homelab, bug bounty or security writeups.
  • First exposure to a SIEM, to detection rules or to log analysis at scale.
  • Curiosity for fraud and abuse patterns in a financial product.

What this internship is not

  • Not a pure GRC, compliance or policy writing internship.
  • Not a pentest internship.
  • Not a role where you watch dashboards without changing them.

Practical details

  • Location: Paris preferred.
  • Duration and start date: 3-6 months internship, ASAP or from January 2027

At Niologic, we promote a culture of openness and diversity in which everyone can develop their individual talents. We ensure that we treat each other with appreciation and respect and are equally committed to our colleagues and society.

Note: In the application process, we use AI-powered systems and Google Gemini as a data processor (with a data center in Frankfurt).

title: Radiologist - Chest CT Annotation - AI Project (UK)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Aptura
description_html:
We are seeking radiologists with a chest/thoracic background to carry out structural annotation on de-identified chest CT scans, with a focus on spatial accuracy and consistency against detailed annotation guidelines.

You will work asynchronously on a dedicated annotation platform, marking points, boxes and measurements on findings that have already been flagged upstream, to support the development of clinical AI imaging models.

This is a remote, flexible and short-term project.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Click-point placement: Mark specific coordinates on a scan, such as the centre of a nodule.

  • Bounding boxes: Draw boxes around defined regions of interest, such as a flagged lesion.

  • Simple measurements: Record diameter, or distance between two marked points, on segmentations or polygons already drawn.

  • Guideline application: Work to an annotation guideline covering placement conventions, boundary definitions and measurement rules, applied consistently across a large volume of studies.

  • Edge case handling: Flag ambiguous cases with a short rationale so guidance can be refined.

This is structural markup project with no interpretation required. You will not be reading scans for diagnosis, judging malignancy, or making clinical decisions.


Qualifications:

  • Registration: Registered radiologist in your country of practice with active license

  • Experience: 3–10 years' experience in radiology, with a chest/thoracic focus

  • Knowledge: Strong grounding in thoracic anatomy and cross-sectional CT.

  • Attention to detail: Proven accuracy and consistency in image review or measurement work.

  • Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured annotation tools and digital platforms.

  • Prior imaging annotation experience is an advantage but not required.

  • Language: Native or near-native written English.


Legal Status:

  • You will have the right to work in your country of residence.

  • You will work as an independent contractor.


Why Join Us?

  • Flexible Work Arrangements: Part-time, remote and fully asynchronous.

  • Competitive Compensation: Hourly rate, paid weekly.

  • Professional Development: Hands-on experience in clinical AI development and medical imaging, shaping how AI systems localise and measure findings on CT.
