title: Head of India
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Taptapsend
description_html:
About Us

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fueling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

Here’s a little more:

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

The Role

India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.

You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.

As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.

Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO

What You'll Own

  • The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.

  • Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.

  • Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.

  • The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.

  • Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.

  • The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.

  • The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

Who You Are

  • 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.

  • Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.

  • Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.

  • A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.

  • A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.

  • Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.

Why This Role

India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.

Taptap Values 

Impact first

Team next

Accept reality

Propose solutions

Win with grit

Be proactively candid, with yourself and others

Love the particular

Own it

Create positive energy

Maybe, even have fun

Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.

If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.

Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.

description_html:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.

We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.

By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.

Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.

Director, Key Accounts

We're seeking a driven, dynamic, and strategic commercial leader to drive growth across our key accounts in Europe. This is a hands-on, high-impact player-coach role focused predominantly on personal account execution paired with informal team leadership and commercial mentoring.

To succeed in this role, you will need a consultative mindset, excellent communication skills, and knowledge of the utilities industry. You will also need a proven track record of commercial execution across large, multi-year, multi-faceted contracts, and experience leading or mentoring a customer-facing team.

What You'll Do

  • Personally own and grow relationships with a portfolio of our most strategic accounts, serving as the senior commercial relationship owner and executive point of contact.

  • Develop and deliver expansion plans across assigned key accounts to execute against business metrics and revenue goals.

  • Coach the team on account strategy, executive engagement, and commercial execution on complex, multi-year contracts.

  • Identify new workflow improvements and use-case opportunities, helping to upskill the broader customer-facing team in commercial best practices.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success Operations, Customer Value Architects, and Product on overall account strategy and execution.

  • Develop processes to scale the Key Account Management function as Neara's European business grows.

  • Co-present with utilities at key conferences and events across Europe, helping elevate Neara’s market presence.

  • Report on account performance, pipeline, and expansion opportunities to senior leadership.

Who You Are

  • Demonstrated history of personally managing and expanding enterprise-level accounts within complex technical or SaaS environments, ideally operating as a Director of Key Accounts, Key Account Manager, Director of Sales, Client Partner, or in a similar enterprise role.

  • Domain exposure to the utilities sector or a similarly complex, technical, infrastructure-heavy industry is highly desirable.

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

The Dealer Resolutions role is on the front line when dealing with high-risk complaints from dealers that require cross-department collaboration. You will be right there resolving complex dealer issues, providing exceptional support, and helping us improve what we do by collaborating across different departments to prevent potential reputational risk. A Dealer Resolutions Specialist will own complex cases from start to finish, handle formal complaints, and provide dedicated support to the dealer throughout the cases' journey, including managing business-critical issues escalated to the C-suite.

What you’ll be doing:

  • High-Stakes Escalation Management: Own and resolve the most complex, sensitive, and high-emotion dealer escalations from intake to final resolution, serving as the definitive point of contact for aggrieved parties.

  • Reputation Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify, assess, and manage potential brand and legal risks embedded in complaints, neutralizing negative exposure across social media, review platforms, and regulatory bodies.

  • Incident Response Coordination: Lead the immediate response to critical service incidents or systemic failures, orchestrating cross-functional communication to ensure impacted customers are managed with transparency, speed, and care.

  • Strategic Goodwill Administration: Exercise autonomous judgment in awarding Gestures of Goodwill (GoGs), financial compensation, or fee waivers, balancing customer retention with commercial viability and internal policy frameworks.

  • Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement: Transform negative feedback into operational intelligence by analyzing complaint data and trend patterns, partnering with leadership to implement process changes that eliminate future friction points.

  • Compliance & Audit Readiness: Ensure all final responses and case documentation strictly adhere to regulatory guidelines, industry compliance standards, and tight internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

What you’ll bring:

  • You’ll have an interest or experience in working in a Marketplace environment

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt quickly in our fast-paced environment

  • Comfortable liaising and communicating with a wide range of stakeholders; from Specialist to C-Suite level

  • You’ll have a collaborative approach to problem-solving; the role will require you to co-ordinate outcomes with multiple teams using great communication skills

  • Dedication to excellent customer service, able to show empathy and understanding to the needs of your customers

  • Excellent communication and writing skills

  • A strong understanding of the motor industry is preferred but not essential

  • An eye for risk assessment, prioritisation, and managing your workload.

  • A preventive rather than a reactive approach; you’ll spot issues before they happen and intervene early

BENEFITS

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

  • Competitive salary

  • Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway's success

About the role

The Specialist Vulnerability Agent plays a critical and empathetic customer-facing role, dedicated to providing exceptional support and holistic case management for our most vulnerable customer population. Building on the core responsibilities of a Front-Line Operations Agent, you will take end-to-end ownership of vulnerable customer journeys from identification to resolution. Vulnerable Customer Case Management & Advocacy

  • Take full ownership and accountability for the end-to-end case management of particularly vulnerable customers, ensuring a seamless and supportive journey from initial identification through to the lifecycle's conclusion.

  • Proactively review and validate the accuracy of customers' vulnerability statuses, ensuring appropriate flags and support mechanisms are in place.

  • Act as a subject matter expert, providing essential support, guidance, and insights to other front-line colleagues on how to identify, interact with, and effectively assist vulnerable customers.

  • Be accountable for and take ownership of decisions regarding the best possible outcomes for our vulnerable customers, exercising sound judgment and empathy in every situation.

  • Responsibility and authority to deviate from standard processes, such as ceasing non-regulatory communications, recommending customers for default, and establishing forbearance arrangements beyond typical front-line limits, to ensure optimal customer outcomes

  • Deliver exceptional support across products/services, efficiently executing processes to handle complex customer queries via multiple channels.

  • Listen actively and provide clear, accurate responses, adapting communication style to each customer’s needs, including those in vulnerable situations or with complex financial queries.

  • Work flexibly across different products and disciplines, adapting to varying service needs and customer queries.

Operational Excellence & Process Execution

  • Meet and exceed targets and KPIs related to customer satisfaction, quality, and compliance by consistently following key operational procedures and applying appropriate judgement to specific customer circumstances.

  • Effectively use AI and digital tools to streamline customer interactions and deliver faster, more accurate service.

  • Identify blockers, process gaps, or recurring issues and communicate these to relevant teams, supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Log all interactions accurately and ensure data integrity for audit and learning purposes.

Continuous Improvement & Process Development

  • Continuously shape and develop our vulnerable customer processes, proactively seeking and integrating external best practices to elevate our support framework.

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback from frontline experiences to enhance our knowledge base, training resources, and AI systems, with a particular focus on vulnerability.

  • Participate in process reviews and contribute suggestions to enhance the customer journey, automation, and operational efficiency, championing the needs of vulnerable customers.

  • Remain up to date with ongoing system, product, and process changes, readily adapting to evolving procedures.

Learning & Development

  • Respond positively to coaching and feedback, using it to improve performance and customer outcomes, especially in complex vulnerability cases.

  • Demonstrate initiative in learning new tools, products, and procedures as they are introduced, with a focus on specialist vulnerability support.

  • Share knowledge and support colleagues, helping to create a culture of collaborative learning around vulnerable customer care.

Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in a contact centre environment with a demonstrable focus on customer service and/or financial support, ideally including exposure to vulnerable customer interactions.

  • Proven ability to handle complex queries with exceptional empathy, accuracy, and strong ownership.

  • Confident in following structured processes and able to identify opportunities to improve them, particularly within the context of vulnerability support.

  • Exceptional communication, rapport-building, and conflict resolution skills, with a proven ability to manage sensitive conversations.

  • Skilled in using digital tools and comfortable adopting new technologies, including AI-driven platforms, to enhance vulnerable customer support.

  • Organised and able to manage multiple complex cases and tasks in a fast-paced setting.

  • Proactive in offering feedback and participating in process and AI improvement initiatives, with a strong voice for vulnerable customer needs.

  • Demonstrated understanding and application of external best practices in vulnerable customer support.

Behaviours & Approach

  • Deep Customer-focus, with a profound passion for delivering consistent, positive and empathetic outcomes for vulnerable individuals.

  • Resilient, adaptable, and open to constant change and learning, especially in evolving vulnerability frameworks.

  • Collaborative, supportive team player committed to shared success, with a strong ability to mentor and guide peers.

  • High level of accountability and personal ownership for vulnerable customer outcomes and process execution.

  • Constructive, solutions-focused approach with willingness to challenge the status quo to advocate for better vulnerable customer experiences.

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

About the role

As Head of Compliance Monitoring, you'll own Lendable's risk-based compliance monitoring programme and lead the team that delivers it. You'll provide independent second line assurance that the business meets its legal and regulatory obligations, and evidence the outcomes customers actually receive rather than the processes behind them.

You'll report to the Head of Compliance (SMF 16, Compliance Oversight) and deputise for them, including at Board meetings and sub-committees. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who has built a second line monitoring function in a UK FCA regulated consumer credit firm and wants the autonomy to shape one in a fast-growing fintech. The role is not itself a Senior Manager Function.

What you’ll be doing/impact on objectives

  • Own the compliance monitoring plan and methodology, refreshing it annually and in-year in response to emerging risks, regulatory change, MI, complaints and FCA publications

  • Maintain a monitoring universe covering PRIN and the Consumer Duty, CONC, SYSC, DISP, SMCR, MCOB, the Consumer Credit Act, financial promotions and UK GDPR

  • Scope and deliver thematic and BAU reviews across the customer journey, including affordability (CONC 5), financial promotions (CONC 3), arrears and forbearance (CONC 7), vulnerability, fees and charges and complaints handling (DISP)

  • Test the design and operating effectiveness of first line controls, and provide second line assurance over first line quality assurance

  • Issue clear, evidence-based reports setting out findings, root cause, risk ratings and owned actions, then track remediation to closure and validate that it worked

  • Escalate actual or potential customer harm promptly, and assess it for redress and for notification to the FCA under Principle 11 and SUP 15

  • Produce monitoring MI for the Head of Compliance, executive management and the Board, and present it at committees

  • Support FCA supervisory engagement, information requests and skilled person (s166) reviews, and coordinate coverage with Internal Audit, Risk and first line QA

  • Bring data protection into scope, testing UK GDPR and DPA 2018 compliance alongside the Data Protection Officer

  • Lead, coach and develop the compliance monitoring team, planning resource against the plan and building capability through data, analytics and better tooling

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrable compliance monitoring experience within a UK FCA regulated firm, including designing, owning and delivering a risk-based compliance monitoring programme

  • Experience of leading, managing and developing a team

  • Consumer credit experience, with a strong working knowledge of CONC and the Consumer Credit Act

  • Strong working knowledge of the FCA Handbook, in particular PRIN and the Consumer Duty, SYSC, DISP and SMCR, and of FCA expectations of a second line monitoring function

  • Data protection knowledge, covering the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018

  • Ability to write clear, concise, evidence-based reports and to present findings credibly to senior management, the Board and its committees

  • Sound judgement and personal resilience, with the independence and confidence to challenge the business constructively and to escalate where necessary

  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to deliver a plan across competing priorities

Highly desirable

  • Internal audit experience gained in a third line function, and/or a relevant professional qualification (for example IIA, ICA or CISI)

  • Secured lending experience, from either a second or third line perspective, including knowledge of MCOB

  • Screening stage: a 15 minute remote cognitive exercise and a 30 minute interview with the Talent Partner

  • 40 minute interview with a Compliance Business Partner (remote)

  • Final onsite interview:

    • 45minute interview with the Head of Compliance

    • 30 minute interviews with CRO

    • 30 minute interview with a product MD

title: Tennis Technical Lead - Data
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Hawkeyeinnovations
description_html:
Tennis Technical Lead (Data), Tennis

Location: UK

You’ll spend the majority of the time either working remotely from home or from our London or Basingstoke office. You won’t be expected to travel often but may want or need to visit event(s) to get an in-person view of how Data generation and distribution is performing and works in our operational workflows. Approximate ratio 85% Office / Remote Work, 15% On Site / Travel.

Reporting to: Tennis Technical Manager

Tennis Technical Team member alongside Technical Manager, Technical Project Managers and Technical Leads

Why Hawk-Eye & Why Tennis?

Join us at Hawk-Eye and be part of an exhilarating journey through the world of sports events. Our operations teams play a crucial role in delivering high-quality experiences at major sporting events worldwide. These are the different areas that you can explore:

  • Technical: Testing, improving and stress testing our systems to enhance the performance of our delivery across the tours.

  • Creative: Working closely with TV directors and external broadcasters to provide statistics and storytelling of insights across tennis matches during live broadcasts.

  • Operations: Reviewing, improving and strategising how we improve the efficiency of delivery across the globe.

  • Projects: On-site management of our service delivery across the globe. Liaising with external stakeholders to organise our technical requirements to be ready and sites to be prepared for our arrival, and to deliver our services to the deadline of the events.

  • Broadcast Production: Rigging and directing live TV broadcasts across the Masters 1000s ATP tour.

 

» Who is the Tennis Technical Team?

The Tennis Technical Team oversees all technical aspects of the department, including the planning and delivery of our technology at events, testing and roll out of new software releases and new products, and advising on hardware specifications. They also directly impact the long term product roadmaps for tennis through reporting bugs, feature requests and new ideas through to the Product and Development teams.

As Data Lead you will fit in as part of the technical pillar within Tennis. At each event there is a Technical Guarantee whose role it is to oversee our full technical delivery including the delivery of our data - this includes the hardware and software set up of Hawk-Eye’s Tennis Data Platform on site. It is this data platform that you as Data Lead will oversee and manage from event to event, ensuring we are producing data that is not only accurate but also distributed in a timely fashion to all contracted clients, meeting all quality of service requirements and service level agreements.

As part of the technical team you will also be regularly interacting with the Product team in order to report detailed findings on the Tennis Data Platform and to continuously move the product forward, ensuring that it is as easy to use as possible. You will also liaise with the Commercial team and Clients to understand all delivery requirements, new services & products requiring data feeds, and advise on the contractual commitments of Hawk-Eye’s data delivery. Equally you will play a pivotal role in educating the operations team to ensure they are best set up for success at every event.

 

» What the job is all about

The role is all about managing the day to day data services that we deliver across all our Tennis events that take place around the globe. In 2021 we rolled out our Tennis Data Platform which manages and produces a whole host of data feeds that are then distributed at various latencies to clients and third parties, as well as used internally to drive products. The management of this live service is essential as well as the storage of the historical data for future use. Data capture and delivery is one of the key foundational services that we provide in the tennis market requiring technical expertise, high attention to detail and well organised individuals to manage it.

Alongside the day to day management of live delivery, the Data Lead will also be driving and testing improvements while working to bring new features to the Tennis Data Platform that improve various aspects of Hawk-Eye’s overall service delivery at tennis events around the World. Equally, the Data Lead will be responsible for onboarding new clients, and supporting the testing of new feeds and features with existing clients.

Our data performance is constantly being assessed by meeting necessary contract service levels. A big part of this role will be producing and assessing data delivery reports, to provide both clients and senior tennis stakeholders with an accurate picture of our data performance from event to event, pinpointing areas of improvement and then helping to implement changes both technically and operationally to address those identified problem areas.

As well as being hands on with the data delivery and assessment, the ideal candidate for this role will also be capable of working with a team of people across operations, product and development teams, as well as clients. There will also be an expectation that this person can manage and coordinate a wider group of people through excellent communication and people management skills, in order to ensure both our live and post event data delivery is fully up to date throughout the tennis calendar year.

There is an expectation for them to have line management capabilities but it is not a requirement of this role.

 

» Overview of Responsibilities

  • Managing the data delivery schedule throughout the tennis calendar

  • Day to day data configuration

  • Quality control

  • Report Generations (both internal and external)

  • Data Delivery Assessment

  • Operational Support

  • Regression testing new releases of software & testing new features

  • Keeping on top of data development deliverables & deadlines

  • Onboarding and facilitating testing with new clients

  • Reporting and Feeding back issues / improvements

  • Data Storage Management

  • Standardising/Aligning Old Data

  • Data Access

  • Managing and executing data reprocessing

  • Full roadmap of the Data Delivery Platform

 

» What we need from you

  • University Degree or equivalent;

  • Experience of working across a global business within a multicultural working environment;

  • Experience introducing and executing new processes across a team;

  • Excellent communication;

  • Attention to detail;

  • Proactive, organised, efficient with time, diligent, able to prioritise and be self-sufficient;

  • A good understanding of the global tennis events framework;

  • Willingness to learn about cloud-based architectures;

  • Ability to be flexible with working hours;

  • Have an interest in statistics;

  • Some knowledge of programming languages

  • Data Analytics Experience

Not necessary but advantageous:

  • Experience using data and analytics tools such as Datadog and Splunk

 

We are…

Brave: The Data Lead demonstrates courage by proactively facilitating collaboration between teams and stakeholders with diverse objectives, confidently navigating differences to achieve alignment and progress in problem-solving initiatives.

Owners: Taking full ownership of their role, the Data Lead ensures the successful implementation of creative and operational strategies, driving excellence in processes and operations to meet the department's goals effectively.

Inclusive: The Data Lead promotes an inclusive environment by actively fostering collaboration and open dialogue within the team, ensuring diverse perspectives are considered in communication, influence, and collaboration efforts to achieve shared objectives.

Equal Opportunity Employer
Hawk-Eye is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We ensure all
employees are treated fairly, regardless of gender, marital status, race, nationality, religion,
age, disability, or union membership status. We value diversity and strive to create an
environment where everyone can reach their full potential.

Apply Today!
This is a fantastic opportunity to join Hawk-Eye Innovations and make a significant impact in sports technology. If you're looking for a role where you can solve real-world problems at scale, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Football Tracking Technician (South Coast)

description_html:
Location: Onsite EPL & EFL Stadiums. We are hiring across the South Coast to cover our partner Premier League and EFL stadiums in Bournemouth and Brighton. Ideal candidates will live within easy commuting distance of both locations.

Contract Type: Casual hourly contract – Setup Day & Match Day
Hourly Rate: £13.00 - £18.20 Per Hour. Rates vary depending on role

Role Overview:

As a Football Tracking Technician, you will work on-site at football stadiums across your region, playing a vital role in the delivery of Hawk-Eye’s tracking and officiating technologies for Premier League, EFL, and UEFA fixtures.

You will be responsible for the setup, calibration, and optimisation of services including Goal Line Technology (GLT) and Electronic Performance & Tracking Systems (EPTS). This includes connecting and configuring PCs and hardware within stadium fibre-optic networks, optimising camera alignments, troubleshooting technical issues in real time, and coordinating closely with remote operations centres, on-site technical leads, and replay operators to ensure seamless match delivery.

Comprehensive technical training and ongoing support will be provided, giving you full exposure to industry-leading sports technology systems and live match operations.

This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience in elite football environments, live broadcast technology, and high-performance sports operations at the highest level of the game.

This role is ideal for individuals looking to gain practical, hands-on experience in sports technology while maintaining a flexible routine. Because live matchday operations follow the football fixture calendar - predominantly concentrated on weekends with occasional midweek commitments for training and fixtures - we are seeking candidates with strong availability to cover these key operational windows.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Stadium Setup: Rigging Hawk-Eye technology at the stadium. Please note: This involves physically demanding work, including running heavy cables, rigging cameras, and working at height.

  • System Calibration: Conducting pre-match setup, hardware checks, and technical calibration of tracking systems in accordance with standard operational procedures.

  • Live Match Monitoring: Actively monitoring hardware and software performance during live matches to instantly troubleshoot, resolve, and report technical errors.

  • Stakeholder Management: Liaising professionally with stadium staff, match officials, and host broadcasters on-site, serving as a trusted brand ambassador for Hawk-Eye

Why Is This The Right Job For You?

We’re looking for individuals who are reliable, professional, and passionate about football. This position is perfect for you if you possess:

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

  • A passion for innovation

  • A willingness to learn

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced and pressurised environment

  • Flexible schedule with primary weekend availability

  • An interest in the sport of Football

Skills and Requirements

Essential Criteria and Skills

  • Technical Foundation: A solid understanding of computer hardware, networking, and fibre-optic connectivity, with a quick aptitude for learning in-house technology and software.

  • Availability & Flexibility: : Strong schedule flexibility, with primary availability focused on weekends and occasional midweek evening matchdays/training sessions in alignment with the football calendar

  • Professionalism: High level of professionalism and a calm, solutions-focused attitude when working in highly visible, client-facing scenarios.

  • Mobility: A full UK driving license

  • Passion: Strong football knowledge and a genuine interest in the sport.

Desirable/Bonus Skills & Experience:

  • Broadcast and Live events experience

  • Video routing Knowledge

  • Experience with Audio Over IP devices

What Difficulties Might I Face?

Up to this point, while there may be many things that you find intriguing about this role, the difficulties you may face should not be ignored.

Working Hours: Due to the nature of the sports industry, there is often work on weekends and midweek evenings, and we are expected to fulfil our roles right to the end.

High-Pressure Situations: Working in a live broadcast environment on a production that is distributed to millions worldwide will bring high levels of pressure

As You Progress:

You may also have the chance to:

  • Opportunities for full-time employment

  • Increase your skillset and be more involved within our team

  • Contribute to improvements in VAR workflows and cutting-edge tech development

We’ll support you every step of the way, but these are roles where focus, resilience, and professionalism are a must.

 

Team Culture

At Hawk-Eye, we pride ourselves on a collaborative, high-performance culture where trust, passion, and innovation thrive. We believe in fostering an environment where every team member is empowered to push boundaries and contribute to the future of sports technology. Our work is guided by three core values:

  • We are Brave: We challenge the status quo, embrace big ideas, and constantly seek new ways to innovate in the sports entertainment industry. We aren't afraid to take risks in pursuit of excellence.

  • We are Owners: We take personal accountability for our work, our decisions, and our collective success. We celebrate our wins together and treat every challenge as an opportunity to learn, grow, and improve.

  • We are Inclusive: We believe our diversity makes us stronger. We cultivate a welcoming environment where unique perspectives are valued, all while being united by our shared love for sports and technology.

description_html:
About Gattaca

Gattaca is an engineering-driven crypto technology company based in London. We build and operate Titan, the largest block builder on Ethereum. We are venture backed and have been profitable for the past 3 years.

Blockchains have created something genuinely new: a trustless, shared layer for financial instruments. For that to work at scale, the network needs infrastructure that can support extremely high throughput and sophisticated trading, while keeping the underlying system decentralised. That's what we build. Ultra-performant infrastructure that keeps decentralised networks efficient.

The role

This role exists to increase the operating leverage of Gattaca’s engineering team.

You’ll sit within the Platform team and focus on the tools and systems around how we build software, operate production and access information internally. Some of that will be traditional developer tooling. Increasingly, a lot of it will involve finding useful ways to apply AI to workflows that previously required an engineer sitting in front of a terminal.

There is a surprising amount of leverage available here. Our systems generate terabytes of data and our engineers can inspect almost every part of what happens inside them, but getting to that information often still requires knowing which database to query, dashboard to open or machine to inspect. The same is true of engineering workflows: useful context is spread across code, production systems, internal messaging, incident notes and individual engineers.

We want to make all of that much easier to use.

The job is to work out where better tooling can remove meaningful friction, then build it properly. Sometimes that will mean a simple internal application. Sometimes it will mean using AI to review code, investigate production issues, query internal data or automate repetitive engineering work.

What you’d work on

Your day-to-day work will span these main areas:

AI-assisted engineering

We want to use AI where it actually improves how we build and operate software. Code review is an obvious example, but there is much more scope around debugging, investigation, repository workflows and repetitive engineering work.

A large part of this role will be working out where those systems are genuinely useful, choosing the right models and tools for the job, and building the infrastructure around them so they become part of normal engineering workflows rather than isolated experiments.

Company knowledge and data

Our systems generate terabytes of data, but getting useful information out of them still often requires knowing which database to query, dashboard to open or machine to inspect. You’ll help build a cleaner layer over that information so people across the company can answer questions without needing to understand where the underlying data happens to live.

The same applies to internal knowledge spread across code, documentation, internal messaging, incident notes and dashboards. We want that context to be easier to find and use, while still making it possible to get down to the raw source when needed.

Internal tooling

You’ll build the tools that remove friction from how people at Gattaca work. That might mean improving CI and deployment workflows, building better interfaces around existing systems, or replacing a manual process with something simple and reliable.

Operational automation

Production systems generate a constant stream of information through alerts, logs, crashes and traces. Today, investigating an issue often means manually piecing together context from several places.

We want to make that loop much tighter. If a builder panics overnight, an agent should eventually be able to gather the relevant logs, inspect the host and codebase, understand what happened and prepare a fix for an engineer to review. If an alert appears in our internal messaging we should be able to investigate it from there rather than starting again from scratch.

Safe execution

The more useful these tools become, the more access they need. An agent that can inspect production, read source code or prepare changes is useful precisely because it can interact with real systems.

You’ll help design the boundaries around that access: what tools can see, what they can change, when a human needs to approve something and how everything is audited. The aim is to make these systems powerful without making them opaque or difficult to control.

How we work

We believe the best work comes from small, focused teams with full ownership over their domain. Deciding what to build and how to build it.

We keep hierarchy as minimal as possible. Engineers own problems, not tasks. You'll have significant autonomy from day one. After a few months you'll be driving the full loop: identifying something worth improving, understanding the problem properly, building it, deploying it and seeing whether it actually made things better.

That matters particularly for this role because many of the most useful projects will not arrive as clearly defined tickets. The tools available are changing quickly, and a large part of the job is noticing where a new capability can remove work or make information easier to access.

We deliberately keep the engineering team small and hire very selectively. That gives this role unusual leverage: a good internal tool or workflow improvement can make a meaningful difference to the output of the whole team. You’ll work alongside engineers from Jane Street, Citadel Securities, Tower Research, Flow Traders, Meta, Google, as well as people from startups and less conventional backgrounds.

Specifics we’re looking for

  • High agency. A lot of the work will start as something vague. You should be comfortable finding these problems yourself, deciding what matters, and taking them from observation through to something people will actually use.

  • Strong software engineering. We have no preference on language. But you should be comfortable building complete systems and moving across backend services, data, infrastructure and simple user interfaces when the problem requires it.

  • Good product judgement. Internal tooling is only useful if it makes people's work noticeably easier. You should have a good instinct for where automation removes real friction, where a simple tool is enough, and where introducing another system would make things worse rather than better.

  • High drive. There is a lot to improve, and platform engineers can be huge levers on team output. We want someone who moves quickly, raises the standard around them, and keeps pushing important work forward without needing a queue of tickets.

Skills we value, but aren’t a requirement

  • Experience building AI agents, tool-using models, evaluation systems or model routing.

  • Experience working with large analytical datasets and making technical data accessible to less technical users.

  • Experience with infrastructure management (AWS or other bare metal providers), automation, CI/CD and observability.

  • Blockchain fundamentals, Ethereum infrastructure, the transaction supply chain, MEV.

No crypto background is required. Several of our strongest engineers came with zero blockchain experience - what transfers is depth and the ability to learn fast.

Logistics

London-based, in-person. The problems we work on are hard enough that the value of in-person collaboration is extremely high. We're very flexible when life requires it, you have agency over how you get the work done, but the default is being in the office with the team.

We sponsor UK work visas for candidates who need them.

Compensation

  • Top-of-market base salary.

  • Bonus tied to company and individual performance.

  • Equity on joining, with more earned through performance.

  • Private healthcare.

  • Third Space gym membership.

description_html:
Introduction to Demandbase:

Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks – all in one platform.

As a company, we’re as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom.

About the Role

The Customer Success Manager II is responsible for growing, supporting, and renewing customer adoption of Demandbase solutions. This is accomplished by partnering with the client to achieve their objectives, driving customer adoption, accelerating time to live and value, and providing B2B digital business expertise.

Responsibilities

  • Own the customer relationship across the full lifecycle, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor to senior marketing stakeholders

  • Drive adoption and value realization of the Demandbase platform, measured through usage, customer outcomes, and goal attainment

  • Partner with customers to deliver proactive ABM best practices, strategies, and use cases, addressing critical success issues and executive priorities

  • Identify and support expansion opportunities within the customer base in partnership with new business teams

  • Lead customer onboarding, project manage ongoing initiatives, and ensure timely resolution of issues through cross-functional coordination

  • Advocate for customers internally while maintaining deep expertise in Demandbase products, industry trends, and the competitive landscape

  • Develop customer success stories, case studies, and references that demonstrate measurable impact

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in strategic account management, customer success, or similar roles supporting SaaS customers

  • Demonstrated success driving expansion through upsell and cross-sell motions, in partnership with sales teams

  • Strong experience coordinating cross-functional teams and leading complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives

  • Deep familiarity with Sales and Marketing technology ecosystems, including CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, intent, predictive analytics, and revenue management tools

  • Proven ability to lead technical or process-driven implementations, identify gaps in customer workflows, and deliver measurable business impact and ROI

Benefits

Our benefits include options for up to 100% paid Medical and Vision premiums for employees, a flexible PTO policy, paid holidays, and access to mental health and wellness resources. We also provide a 401(k) with pre-tax, after tax, and roth options, as well as short-term/long-term disability, life insurance, and other great benefits.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase

At Demandbase, we believe in creating a workplace culture that values and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We recognize that everyone brings unique experiences, perspectives, and identities to the table, and we are committed to building a community where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. Discrimination of any kind is not tolerated, and we strive to ensure that every individual has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow, regardless of their gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, background, marital status, genetic information, education level, veteran status, national origin, or any other protected status. We do not automatically disqualify applicants with criminal records and will consider each applicant on a case-by-case basis.

We recognize that not all candidates will have every skill or qualification listed in this job description. If you feel you have the level of experience to be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply!

We acknowledge that true diversity and inclusion requires ongoing effort, and we are committed to doing the work required to make our workplace a safe and equitable space for all. Join us in building a community where we can learn from each other, celebrate our differences, and work together.

Unsolicited Submissions

At Demandbase, we value thoughtful partnerships and direct connections with candidates. We’re not accepting unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-party recruiting agencies. Any unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed, and no fees will be paid.

title: Quality Complaint Specialist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Hims And Hers
description_html:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Complaint Specialist to support our UK Superintendent Pharmacist and Quality teams across two connected areas of our pharmacy operation: supporting the triage, submission to suppliers, trending and investigation of quality complaints received from patients/customers dispensed commercially licensed medicines sourced from pharmaceutical wholesalers/suppliers, and the quality complaint investigation process for our non-sterile compounding (unlicensed "specials") pharmacy. This role is central to ensuring that every product-quality complaint — whether tied to a licensed dispensed product or a compounded preparation — is captured, investigated, and closed out in a manner that satisfies MHRA expectations, the Human Medicines Regulations 2012 (including the Article 10/Section 10 exemption framework for unlicensed specials), and our internal Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS). You will work closely with the Superintendent Pharmacist, Responsible Pharmacists, Quality Control Teams, compounding staff and Pharmaceutical wholesalers/suppliers to ensure patient safety, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement are at the centre of everything we do.

You Will:

  • Serve as the second point of intake for product-quality complaints relating to dispensed commercial medicines and non-sterile compounded (Article 10 "specials") preparations, logging each complaint accurately and promptly in the complaint management system.

  • Support the Superintendent Pharmacist in triaging incoming complaints to determine severity, patient safety impact, and whether escalation (e.g., potential recall, MHRA Yellow Card, or Defective Medicines Report Centre notification) is required.

  • Lead and/or support end-to-end complaint investigations, including root cause analysis, batch/lot traceability, retained sample review, where applicable, and liaison with the originating pharmaceutical supplier or wholesaler where the complaint concerns a commercially sourced product.

  • Support complaint investigations specific to non-sterile compounded preparations, ensuring alignment with MHRA guidance on unlicensed medicines ("specials"), Human Medicines Regulations 2012 (Article 10/Regulation 3, Schedule 1 exemptions), and applicable professional standards (GPhC, RPS non-sterile compounding guidance).

  • Draft clear, well-evidenced investigation reports and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) plans, when applicable; track CAPAs to timely closure and verify effectiveness.

  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation in line with Good Documentation Practice (GDP), including complaint files, correspondence with patients/prescribers/suppliers, and trending data.

  • Identify and report trends in complaint data to the Superintendent Pharmacist and Quality leadership, flagging recurring issues that may indicate a systemic quality or supply issue.

  • Support the Superintendent Pharmacist in maintaining the pharmacy's compliance with MHRA inspection readiness, GPhC standards for registered pharmacies, and relevant SOPs governing complaint handling, deviations, and non-conformances.

  • Assist with drafting, reviewing, and revising SOPs related to complaint handling, non-conformance management, and supplier quality as it relates to complaint handling for both the dispensing and compounding operations.

  • Liaise with pharmaceutical suppliers and wholesalers to ensure appropriate records are available as necessary to close out applicable complaint investigations, when necessary.

  • Support internal audits and MHRA/GPhC inspections by preparing complaint files, trend reports, and CAPA evidence.

  • Escalate any signal of a potential quality defect, adverse reaction, or patient safety risk to the Superintendent Pharmacist without delay.

You Have:

  • 3+ years Experience in a pharmacy, pharmaceutical quality, or regulatory affairs role within the UK, ideally within a dispensing pharmacy, wholesaler, or compounding/"specials" manufacturing environment.

  • Working knowledge of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012, including the Article 10 exemption framework for unlicensed "specials," and familiarity with MHRA guidance on complaint handling, recalls, and Defective Medicines Reporting.

  • Understanding of GPhC standards for registered pharmacies and pharmacy professionals, and experience supporting a Superintendent Pharmacist or Responsible Pharmacist in a regulated environment.

  • Familiarity with non-sterile compounding practices and associated quality/regulatory expectations (e.g., RPS professional guidance on unlicensed specials).

  • Strong root cause analysis and CAPA experience; comfort applying structured investigation methodologies (e.g., 5 Whys, fishbone/Ishikawa).

  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, defensible investigation reports for regulators, auditors, and internal stakeholders.

  • High attention to detail and strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple open investigations against defined timelines.

  • Experience with quality management systems (QMS) or complaint-tracking databases preferred.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

title: Commercial Account Executive
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Zip
description_html:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

  • You’re a closer, trusted advisor, product consultant – you’re working with prospects day-in-day-out to deliver immense ROI in an efficient, value-based sales cycle

  • You’re a hunter – you’ll get a healthy supply of BDR leads and marketing opportunities, but you’ll prospect and tap into your network to knock down doors and blockers

  • You’re a product evangelist – you’ll solution Zip to meet the pain points today, but also with an eye toward our product of the future

  • You’re a builder – at a startup, you’re not just a team member, but you help build the team culture and bring your best practice to the org

You Will

  • Become a product expert – learning the Zip platform through and through, so that you’re demo ready

  • Become a procurement expert – learning the ins and outs of the procurement market, which is deeply ready for change and new solutions

  • Use cutting-edge sales intelligence and engagement solutions to prospect, manage deal cycles, and ultimately bring on new customers

  • Be adaptable and flexible – as part of an early-stage hyper growth company, we are rapidly growing out our process but we want to you to help shape our sales process

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of closing experience in technology SaaS sales

  • Self driven – you don’t need someone to motivate you to put in your best every day

  • You’d describe yourself as organized, efficient with your time, and excellent communicator

  • Experience using tools like Salesforce, Zoominfo, LinkedIn SalesNav, and Outreach

  • Willing to go the extra mile to make sure our customers, company, team, and yourself succeed

  • a Bachelor’s degree is required (specifically in Finance, Technology, or a related field or experiential equivalent)

  • Able to come into our office 3 days per week

Nice to Haves

  • Experience selling to procurement, finance, IT, legal 

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈  Start-up equity

  • 🚠  Team building events & happy hours

  • 🌴  Flexible PTO

  • 💻  Apple equipment plus home office budget

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Happyhotel
description_html:
Als Senior Machine Learning Engineer arbeitest du im Pricing & Revenue-Kontext an datengetriebenen Verbesserungen für Forecasting, Pricing-Logiken und Produkt-Insights. Du baust Analysen und Modelle, die im Produkt messbar Wirkung zeigen – mit sauberer Evaluation, solider Datenbasis und pragmatischer Umsetzung. Du arbeitest dabei eng mit Product & Engineering zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Model Evolution: Du entwickelst und optimierst unsere Forecasting- und Pricing-Modelle sowie datengetriebene Decision-Logiken, immer methodisch pragmatisch und voll auf Impact ausgerichtet.

  • Signal Hunting: Du arbeitest mit Zeitreihen, Demand-Signalen und heterogenen Datenquellen. Du definierst Features und Labels so sauber, dass Leakage keine Chance hat.

  • Measurement & Guardrails: Du verantwortest die Evaluation durch Backtests, robuste Metriken und Segmentierungen. Du unterstützt bei Holdouts sowie A/B-Logiken und behältst den Check zwischen Offline- und Online-Performance.

  • Best Practices im ML Engineering: Du setzt neue Maßstäbe für Backtesting, Reproduzierbarkeit und Versionierung. Für uns zählt: Engineering-Qualität statt reiner Notebook-Lösungen.

  • Data Visibility: Du baust Dashboards und Reports aus, die Modell- und Business-KPIs transparent machen. Dein Fokus liegt dabei immer auf höchster Data Quality.

  • Smart Workflows: Du treibst reproduzierbare Workflows voran (Versionierung, saubere Pipelines, sinnvolle Tests) und automatisierst wiederkehrende Analysen sowie Evaluationsläufe.

Dein Profil

  • Track Record: Du hast 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in Data Science oder Applied ML Engineering gesammelt – idealerweise direkt im Produkt- oder Business-Kontext.

  • Data Intuition: Du besitzt extrem starke SQL-Skills und ein tiefes Gespür für Datenqualität, Debugging und konsistente Metriken.

  • Python Pro: Dein Python-Code ist sauber und deine Analysen sind nachvollziehbar. Erste Erfahrung mit produktnahen Setups ist ein großes Plus.

  • Experiment-Mindset: Du beherrscht die Grundlagen von Bias/Leakage-Awareness und weißt, wie man in Guardrails und Offline-vs-Online-Szenarien denkt.

  • Work Style: Du übernimmst volle Ownership für deine Themen. Du arbeitest nach dem 80/20-Prinzip (pragmatisch!), bist zuverlässig und kommunizierst glasklar.

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: Du denkst unternehmerisch und willst Dinge wirklich bewegen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit.

Nice‑to‑haves – was die Besten auszeichnet

  • Domain Expertise: Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Revenue Management oder Dynamic Pricing (z. B. Hotel, Travel, eCommerce oder Mobility).

  • Demand Knowledge: Du kennst dich mit Saisonalität, Events, Lead Times und Segment-Mustern aus.

  • Modern Stack: Du hast schon mit Analytics Engineering oder Warehouse-Tools wie dbt, Snowflake oder Metabase gearbeitet.

  • Hands-on MLOps & Cloud: Ein Plus ist praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit MLOps-Tools und Cloud-Infrastruktur, z. B. AWS.


Wir sind angetreten, um die Hotellerie nicht nur zu digitalisieren, sondern ihre technologische Basis auf ein neues Level zu heben. Wenn du Lust hast, die Verantwortung für das technische Rückgrat eines Millionen-Portfolios zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Generation des automatisierten Revenue Managements zu skalieren, dann lass uns reden!

Bewirb dich jetzt – wir freuen uns darauf, gemeinsam mit dir den nächsten Meilenstein von happyhotel zu setzen.

title: Werkstudent:in - Social Media / Content Creation
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at VF Nutrition GmbH
description_html:
Jobbeschreibung

Hey!

Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun, sondern auch unserem Planeten. Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Um unserer Community noch näher zu kommen, brauchen wir Dich!

Deine Mission: Als Werkstudent:in im Social Media Bereich schaffst du echten Content-Impact für die Marke vly. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Social Media Manager:in sowie dem E-Commerce & Marketing Team unterstützt du dabei sowohl im organischen Bereich als auch für unsere Performance Ads.

Dein Profil:

  • Hands-on Content Creation: Du entwickelst zusammen mit dem Social Media Team kreative Ideen, stehst vor der Kamera und nimmst eigenen Content auf (Fokus auf IG Reels & TikTok).
  • Editing & Post-Production: Du schneidest deine gedrehten Videos eigenständig mit CapCut.
  • Format- & Grafik-Erstellung: Du erstellst ergänzende visuelle Assets mit Canva und nutzt moderne KI-Tools, um deinen Workflow zu beschleunigen.
  • Trend-Scouting & Testing: Social Media ist deine Leidenschaft. Du verfolgst aktuelle Trends täglich und identifizierst aktiv virale Formate für unsere Social Media Präsenz und hast Spaß dabei, diese vor der Kamera direkt umzusetzen.
  • Content-Skalierung & Assets: In Zusammenarbeit mit dem Performance Team drehst und schneidest du Performance Ads und kreierst neue Hooks für unsere Zielgruppen.

Deine Benefits:

  • Werde Teil unserer Mission: Sei dabei, den Wandel von tierischen zu pflanzlichen Proteinen voranzutreiben!
  • Eine faszinierende Branche - Milchprodukte sind in fast jedem Haushalt zu finden, Haferm*lch und Blutzucker ist in den sozialen Netzwerken allgegenwärtig und die Bedeutung von Gesundheit nimmt ständig zu.
  • Echtes Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.
  • Teamlunch: Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserem eigener vly-Köchin!
  • Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket als auch zu deiner USC-Mitgliedschaft.
  • FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten.
  • vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!

Stellenanforderungen

Hey! Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert.   • Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket als auch zu deiner USC-Mitgliedschaft.

title: Servicekräfte / Eventlogistik / Eventpersonal (m/w/d) ab 17 €/Std.
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Prestige Service GmbH
description_html:
Du hast Spaß daran, mit Menschen zu arbeiten und möchtest neben Schule, Studium oder Ausbildung flexibel in der Gastronomie und bei Events arbeiten?

Dann könnte Prestige Service zu dir passen.

Wir unterstützen Veranstaltungen und Eventlocations in Berlin mit unserem Team.

Dabei ist uns wichtig, dass du dich bei uns wohlfühlst und weißt, mit wem du arbeitest. Deshalb lernst du uns persönlich kennen, wirst auf deine ersten Einsätze vorbereitet und bekommst eine Schulung. Danach entscheidest du selbst, welche Einsätze zu dir und deinem Alltag passen.

Aufgaben

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

  • 17 € / Stunde zum Einstieg
  • flexible Einsätze, die zu deinem Alltag passen
  • verschiedene Veranstaltungen und Locations in Berlin
  • persönliche Ansprechpartner
  • Schulung und Vorbereitung vor deinen ersten Einsätzen
  • ein junges Team, in dem man sich kennt und gegenseitig unterstützt
  • regelmäßige Teamevents
  • die Möglichkeit, mit der Zeit mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Unterstützung bei der Logistik vor Ort, wie Auf- und Abbau sowie das Handling von Veranstaltungsmaterialien
  • Koordination und Organisation des reibungslosen Ablaufs der Events in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team

Qualifikation

Qualifikationen

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die Kommunikation mit internationalen Gästen
  • Organisatorische Fähigkeiten, um mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig zu koordinieren
  • Freundliches Auftreten, Teamfähigkeit und Flexibilität in einem lebendigen Umfeld
  • Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten
  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie Verantwortungsbewusstsein

Gastro-Erfahrung?

Erfahrung ist natürlich gerne gesehen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wenn du motiviert bist, offen auf Menschen zugehst und Lust hast, etwas Neues zu lernen, bringen wir dir die wichtigsten Grundlagen bei.

Du musst kein Profi sein. Uns ist wichtiger, dass du zuverlässig bist, freundlich auf Menschen zugehst und auch dann einen kühlen Kopf behältst, wenn es mal etwas hektischer wird. Ein gepflegtes Auftreten und ein respektvoller Umgang mit Gästen und deinen Kollegen gehören für uns selbstverständlich dazu.

Wenn du glaubst, dass du gut zu uns passt, bewerbe dich gerne oder schreib uns einfach eine Nachricht, in der du uns von dir erzählst und deinen Lebenslauf hinzufügst.

Branche: Zeitarbeitsdienstleistungen

Beschäftigungsverhältnis: Zeitarbeit

description_html:
ORDERMONKEY entwickelt moderne Self-Ordering-Lösungen für die Gastronomie, QSR-, Franchise- und Hospitality-Branche. Mit unseren Self-Order-Kiosken, QR-Ordering, Webshops, Payment- und weiteren digitalen Lösungen helfen wir Gastronomiebetrieben dabei, Bestellprozesse zu automatisieren, Wartezeiten zu reduzieren und ihren Umsatz zu steigern.

Für unseren weiteren Wachstumskurs in Deutschland und DACH suchen wir eine vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit, die nicht nur verkaufen, sondern gemeinsam mit uns einen Markt weiterentwickeln möchte.

Aufgaben

Als Sales & Partner Manager Germany (m/w/d) übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle beim weiteren Ausbau von ORDERMONKEY in Deutschland und DACH.

Die Position kombiniert Direct Sales & Partner Management. Dein Fokus liegt zunächst klar auf Deutschland. Perspektivisch unterstützt du uns dabei, einen skalierbaren Partner-Channel für den gesamten DACH-Raum aufzubauen.

  • Aufbau und kontinuierliche Entwicklung deiner eigenen Sales Pipeline in Deutschland
  • Identifikation und Akquise neuer Kunden aus Gastronomie, QSR, Franchise und Hospitality
  • Durchführung von Erstgesprächen, Produkt-Demos und Präsentationen
  • Erstellung von Angeboten sowie Führung von Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen
  • Begleitung des gesamten Sales-Prozesses bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss
  • Identifikation und Gewinnung neuer Reselling- und Vertriebspartner
  • Aufbau von Beziehungen zu POS-Anbietern, Kassenintegratoren, Gastro-IT-Unternehmen sowie Payment- und Technologiepartnern
  • Präsentation und Weiterentwicklung des ORDERMONKEY Partner-Modells & Langfristiger Aufbau eines skalierbaren Partner-Channels für Deutschland und den DACH-Raum

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B Sales, Business Development oder einer vergleichbaren VertriebsrolleErfahrung im POS-/Kassensystem-Umfeld ist für diese Position zwingend erforderlich
  • Gute Kenntnisse der Strukturen und Entscheidungsprozesse in der Gastronomie, idealerweise im Bereich Gastro-Tech, POS, Payment oder Hospitality Technology
  • Erfahrung in der aktiven Neukundengewinnung, Idealerweise Erfahrung im Partner-, Reseller- oder Channel Sales
  • Fähigkeit, SaaS- und Technologieprodukte verständlich und überzeugend zu präsentieren
  • Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten sowie sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Entscheidern
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und unternehmerische Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Kunden- und Partnerterminen innerhalb Deutschlands

Benefits

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Management sowie unseren Sales-, Product- und Operations-Teams zusammen und hast direkten Einfluss darauf, wie wir unseren Direct-Sales- und Partner-Channel weiterentwickeln.

Dich erwartet ein internationales Tech-Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung und großem Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir setzen auf selbstständiges Arbeiten und Vertrauen statt auf starre Strukturen.

Dank unseres Remote-/Hybrid-Modells kannst du deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend flexibel und eigenständig organisieren. Du planst deine Termine, Kundenbesuche und Sales-Aktivitäten selbst und hast die Freiheit, deine Arbeit so einzuteilen, wie sie für deine Ziele und deinen Markt am sinnvollsten ist.

Gleichzeitig bist du Teil eines internationalen Teams und arbeitest eng mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen. Bei ORDERMONKEY hast du die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, eigene Ideen einzubringen und den nächsten Wachstumsschritt unseres Geschäfts in Deutschland aktiv mitzugestalten.

Du kennst den POS-Markt, bist stark im Vertrieb und möchtest nicht nur Deals abschließen, sondern aktiv etwas aufbauen und einen Markt mitentwickeln? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Werde Teil von ORDERMONKEY und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft des Self-Orderings in der Gastronomie.

title: Medical Director (m/w/x)
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Doctorflix
description_html:
Role

Als Medical Director verantwortest du den medizinischen Themenkatalog einer der größten CME-Lernplattformen Deutschlands. Was wir zeigen, erreicht unzählige Ärzt:innen – deine inhaltlichen Entscheidungen haben unmittelbaren Einfluss darauf, welches medizinische Wissen in Deutschland ankommt.

Du führst unser siebenköpfiges Medical Team, hältst den Kontakt zu Chefärzt:innen und Meinungsbildner:innen, entwickelst neue Fortbildungsformate mit und baust die Prozesse, mit denen wir vom Startup zum Scale-up werden. Die Rolle ist bewusst breit: strategisch in der Katalog- und Formatentwicklung, operativ im Tagesgeschäft, und immer mit der ärztlichen Perspektive als Maßstab.


Your tasks

  • Verantwortung für den Themenkatalog: Du steuerst, welche medizinischen Themen wir abdecken – fachübergreifend, evidenzbasiert und mit einem klaren Blick für Versorgungsrelevanz und Lücken im Markt.

  • Referenten-Netzwerk: Du bist tagtäglich im Austausch mit Chefärzt:innen und KOLs, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und gewinnst daraus kontinuierlich neue Fortbildungsideen.

  • Team-Leadership: Du führst und entwickelst unser Medical Team – zwei Vollzeitkolleg:innen und fünf Studierende. Die Medical Editors arbeiten inhaltlich und stimmen Projekte mit Sponsoren und Referent:innen ab; die Medical Students übernehmen Quality Control, erstellen Kursbeschreibungen und entwickeln neue Themenideen.

  • Formatentwicklung: Wir produzieren Videos, Panel-Diskussionen und E-Learnings – Form und Inhalt greifen ineinander. Bei neuen Formaten wie Kurzvideos oder der Gamification des Lernerlebnisses ist dein medizinischer Input und die ärztliche Perspektive der entscheidende Faktor.

  • Projekt- und Themensteuerung: Du managst die Themenideen laufender Projekte und stimmst dich eng mit Referent:innen ab, damit Projektanforderungen inhaltlich sauber umgesetzt werden.

  • Qualitätssicherung & Compliance: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Fortbildungen den CME-Standards entsprechen, evidenzbasiert sind und die regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllen.

  • Prozessverbesserung & Automatisierung: Auf unserem Weg zum Scale-up stehen Automatisierung und schlanke Prozesse im Mittelpunkt. Du streamlinest Workflows und Dokumentationstools im Team und teamübergreifend – als Director bist du dabei die Schlüsselrolle für funktionierende Cross-Department-Zusammenarbeit.


Your profile

  • Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Medizin.

  • Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, gern klinisch, in der Industrie oder in der digitalen Gesundheitsbranche.

  • Führungserfahrung: Erste Erfahrung als Team Lead ist ein klarer Vorteil – entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen entwickeln und Prioritäten setzen kannst.

  • Anpack-Mindset: Wir skalieren. Du regelst Dinge selbst, statt sie nur zu delegieren, und scheust dich nicht davor, auch operativ mit reinzugehen.

  • Begeisterung für Prozesse: Du hast Freude an Projektmanagement, Strukturaufbau und medizinischem Content bzw. medizinischer Lehre – diese Kombination ist der Kern der Rolle.

  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in einem Startup sowie in der medizinischen Lehre.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber führenden Mediziner:innen und Industriepartnern, professioneller Kommunikationsstil mündlich und schriftlich.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch sind Voraussetzung.


Why us?

  • Echter Impact: Die Themen, die du verantwortest, erreichen über zig tausende Ärzt:innen. Durch die Verbreitung des neuesten medizinischen Wissens hast du direkten Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität in Deutschland.

  • Mitgestaltung: Du prägst neue Fortbildungsformate und den medizinischen Qualitätsanspruch der Plattform von Grund auf mit.

  • Wachstum & Perspektive: Wir wachsen schnell – entsprechend gibt es echte Aufstiegs- und Gestaltungschancen, die mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen.
