title: Senior Scaled Enablement Manager (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Maltego
description_html:
Why we need you

Maltego helps organisations uncover complex relationships and connections across people, organisations, infrastructure, and digital assets. Our platform is used by investigators, security professionals, law enforcement agencies, and enterprises worldwide to accelerate investigations and make better decisions with connected data. As we continue to grow, we're expanding our Customer Enablement team to help more customers achieve value at scale. 
We're looking for a Senior Scaled Enablement Manager to design and lead scalable customer enablement programmes that help customers successfully adopt and expand their use of Maltego products. This role sits at the intersection of customer enablement, programme management, customer education, and product adoption. You'll create repeatable experiences that enable hundreds of customers to learn, adopt, and realise value through webinars, cohort programmes, workshops, office hours, self-service content, and usage-driven interventions. 
Rather than working with a small portfolio of strategic accounts one-to-one, your focus will be on creating programmes and systems that deliver meaningful outcomes across an entire customer segment. You'll play a key role in shaping how Maltego scales customer success and adoption as we continue to grow.


What to expect

  • Own the scaled enablement motion, designing live, repeatable programmes that drive product adoption, engagement, and value realisation.
  • Build and maintain a cohort and enablement roadmap aligned with customer needs, product priorities, and business objectives.
  • Develop and optimise repeatable scaled customer journeys that support onboarding, adoption, expansion, and re-engagement at scale.
  • Plan and deliver webinars, workshops, cohort-based training programmes, office hours, and other one-to-many customer learning experiences.
  • Create and maintain high-quality enablement content, including training materials, guides, playbooks, videos, and knowledge base resources.
  • Leverage AI and automation tools to improve programme design, content creation, customer insight generation, and operational efficiency across scaled enablement initiatives.
  • Analyse customer engagement and product adoption data, using AI-assisted insights where appropriate, to identify trends, opportunities, and targeted intervention strategies.
  • Measure and improve programme effectiveness using customer feedback, usage insights, and business performance metrics.
  • Partner closely with Account Managers, Customer Enablement SMEs, Product Management, Marketing, and Operations teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
  • Define and evolve scalable operating models, processes, and best practices that enable customer success programmes to grow efficiently with the business.


Your profile in short

Required Qualifications (Must Have)

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in Customer Success, Customer Enablement, Customer Education, Customer-facing Programme Management, Product Adoption, Training, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
  • Experience designing, delivering, and improving scalable customer programmes, including webinars, cohorts, workshops, office hours, or other one-to-many formats in a SaaS or technology environment.
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, written communication, and content development skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate customer insights and usage data into actionable adoption strategies.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).
Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)
  • Experience with customer success, customer education, learning management, or community platforms.
  • Experience using customer success platforms such as Planhat, Gainsight, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with product adoption analytics, customer engagement metrics, and data-driven programme optimisation.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, investigations, intelligence, OSINT, SaaS, or B2B software environments.
  • Experience creating self-service learning content, structured learning paths, or customer training curricula


Why you will love Maltego

Maltego is a scale-up company. We provide you the benefits and security of larger corporations coupled with the dynamic and fast-paced work environment and flat hierarchies of a start-up. We are proud to have a large global community that loves our product because it helps to solve the investigations that are most important. 
Here are some of the reasons why you will love Maltego: 

  • Help shape a newly evolving customer enablement function 
  • Work with unique technology used by investigators and analysts around the world 
  • Build programmes that influence customer outcomes at scale 
  • Collaborate with passionate and highly skilled colleagues across the business 
  • Have a direct impact on customer adoption, retention, and growth
 At Maltego, we are committed to supporting diversity and inclusion in our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, religion, color, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.


Location

Based in our Munich office, with a flexible hybrid working model requiring a minimum of 2 days per week in the office

Ready to help drive the future of digital investigations? Apply now with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your experience!

title: AI Engineer - Dealflow (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Flex Capital Management Gmbh
description_html:
Info:

Als AI-Engineer - Dealflow entwickelst und verantwortest du das Produkt bzw. Tool, mit dem wir unseren proprietären Dealflow im Investmentteam im DACH-Software- und Tech-Mittelstand aufbauen. Dein Ziel: Attraktive Unternehmen und ihre Gesellschafter frühzeitig identifizieren und erreichen, idealerweise bevor ein M&A-Berater mandatiert oder ein breiter Verkaufsprozess gestartet wird. 
 
Dabei verbindest du zwei Welten: AI-Skills und Deal Origination. Du baust die Daten-, Tool- und Reporting-Infrastruktur, auf der Market Maps, Outbound-Kampagnen und potenzielle Investments und ein skalierbarer Sourcing-Prozess aufsetzen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem FLEX Leadership Team, dem Investment Team und dem Data & AI Team zusammen und du erhältst vom ersten Tag an viel Ownership für den Aufbau einer zentralen Funktion bei FLEX.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust und verantwortest das AI-Produkt/Tool, das unseren Origination-Funnel kontinuierlich mit Software- und Technologieunternehmen im DACH-Mittelstand befüllt. Du entwickelst es laufend weiter und verbesserst es iterativ.
  • Du entwickelst die Screening- und Priorisierungslogik für Targets und verbesserst deren Trefferqualität systematisch.
  • Du baust die automatisierte Datenbeschaffung und -anreicherung aus, sodass Targets angereichert werden mit Firmographics und Eigentümerstrukturen.
  • Du entwickelst Logik und Workflows, um Intent-Signale und potenzielles Verkaufsinteresse zu erkennen.
  • Du initiierst die automatisierte Multichannel-Ansprache und entwickelst die zugrunde liegenden Prozesse weiter.
  • Du baust Dashboards und Reports zu Funnel, Aktivitäten und Conversion als Grundlage unserer Sourcing- und Pipeline-Reviews.
  • Du evaluierst neue Prospecting- und Sourcing-Tools und entwickelst Ansprache, Sequenzen und unsere Messaging-Bibliothek weiter.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast eigene Tools und Automatisierungen gebaut, die produktiv im Einsatz waren, nicht nur Prototypen und Demos.
  • Du bringst mindestens 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau AI-basierter Produkte/Tools mit.
  • Du entwickelst selbstständig in Python und deployst mit Docker auf Azure in Produktion. Du kennst LLM-APIs (OpenAI, Claude) aus der Praxis und weißt, wo sie zuverlässig funktionieren und wo (noch) nicht.
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Daten und weißt, worauf es bei Datenqualität und -struktur ankommt. Kenntnisse in Pipedrive, Agentensystemen sowie Frameworks wie LangGraph sind ein Plus.
  • Du denkst kommerziell: Du verstehst, warum ein Target relevant ist und misst dich an Ergebnissen.
  • Du hast ein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Data Analytics, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren MINT-Fach erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch.


Benefits

  • Raum zum Wachsen und die Möglichkeit, viel Verantwortung zu übernehmen, kombiniert mit halbjährlichem Feedback und einem individuellen Weiterbildungsbudget. 
  • Persönliche und berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch ein inspirierendes und dynamisches Umfeld und flache Hierarchien.   
  • Regelmäßige Events, ein gemeinsamer Sommerurlaub sowie verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote wie beispielsweise zweimonatliche Massage / Physiotherapie im Büro.   
  • Moderne und ergonomische Arbeitsmittel, ein Office im Herzen Berlins direkt am Park am Gleisdreieck sowie eine voll ausgestattete Küche mit gesunden Snacks, Softdrinks und einem monatlichen Friday Beer/Sekt/Wein. 
  • Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket inklusive Möglichkeiten zur Brutto-Netto-Optimierung.  


Über uns

FLEX Capital ist ein Private Equity Fonds, der sich auf Wachstums- und Buy-out-Möglichkeiten im deutschen Software- und Tech-Mittelstand fokussiert. Hinter FLEX Capital stehen sechs Seriengründer, die mehrfach marktführende Unternehmen mit internationaler Geschäftstätigkeit aufgebaut haben. Auf dieser Basis teilt das FLEX-Team seine Erfahrungen mit Unternehmern und Management Teams, unterstützt sie Hands-on und hilft ihnen so, die gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (all genders)

description_html:
Your Mission

reev is building the Energy Hub for EV charging and energy management across Europe - the platform that companies, operators, and drivers use every day to run their charging and energy infrastructure. 
We're looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer to help build and evolve one of the core areas of the reev platform. You'll work across the stack, take ownership of meaningful product areas end-to-end, and help shape how we deliver value to operators and drivers across Europe. 

What You'll Do
 
Our stack is Kotlin on the backend, React for the reev hub, React Native for the driver apps, all running on AWS. You'll work across all of it, closely with your PM and designers. 

  • Design, build, and ship features across backend, web, and mobile that operators and drivers rely on daily.
  • Own projects from discovery and technical design through rollout and continuous improvement.
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions with customer and business impact in mind.
  • Raise the bar on quality, reliability, performance, and security through code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.


What you bring along

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping fullstack products.
  • Solid experience across frontend and backend. Kotlin, React, React Native, and AWS are our stack; equivalent JVM, TypeScript, and cloud experience is welcome.
  • A product mindset: you stay close to users, make thoughtful trade-offs, and use feedback to improve what you build.
  • Care for engineering quality - testing, observability, maintainability, and the day-to-day experience of the people using your software.
  • Comfort using AI tools daily to think, prototype, and unblock yourself.
  • Clear communication in English. German is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Bonus: experience in B2B SaaS, energy, or mobility.


What you can expect from us

How we work
Clear goals. Real ownership. No politics. We move fast, decide together, and hold each other accountable - because progress beats perfection. Monthly team events and regular cross-office collaboration between Munich and Zagreb keep us connected as one team. 

Where you'll work 
Our office at Stiglmaierplatz is where collaboration happens - in person, direct, eye to eye. For this role, we expect you on-site at least three days per week, because great things happen when you're in the same room. 

What You Get 

  • 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest.
  • Mental health, taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive.
  • AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down.
  • Move sustainably - JobRad, subsidised public transport, or EGYM Wellpass. You choose what fits your life.
  • €1,000 learning budget - Yours to use. Plus internal development opportunities. Because when you grow, we all grow.
  • Your future, sorted - Digital, commission-free company pension (bAV) with DYNO. Transparent, with a personal dashboard. No fine print.
Benefits may vary slightly by location.

title: Senior Business Intelligence Lead (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Reev
description_html:
Your Mission

EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question. 
This role addresses the problem - not by building more dashboards, but by creating a shared and trustworthy data foundation. The goal is to establish clear definitions and consistent metrics so that teams and leadership can make informed decisions based on the same numbers. Someone who understands that unclear definitions, rather than a lack of data, are often the real problem can make a significant impact in this role. You own the certified layer, the single, agreed upon version of every core metric that reev runs on. You connect the definition, the data model, and the delivery. And when two numbers disagree, you are the person who says which one to trust. 

What you will do 

  • Define core metrics with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Engineering, and Platform.
  • Agree on definitions, data contracts, and ownership forcore metrics with the teams that own them.
  • Maintain and verify the certified data layer, built in ETL tooland surfaced in Metabase, so teams can build their own dashboards on top of it.
  • Use SQL to validate data, investigate inconsistencies, and trace numbers back to their sources.
  • Work with Platform team to identify potential improvements in data flows, pipelines, and transformations, advise on next steps, and help prioritize next steps during planning.
  • Help stakeholders decide which number to trust when reports disagree.
  • Improve data literacy through practical guidance, workshops, and clear documentation.
  • Use AI-assisted tools for analysis, documentation, automation, and workflows. Check the results carefully.
 
What this role is not 
You will not be the central owner of every dashboard request. Teams remain responsible for their own dashboards, analyses, and data models built on their data contracts. This is also not a classic infrastructure or people-management role. 



What you bring along

Must-have 

  • Senior experience in BI, analytics, or data. Scale-up experience is helpful.
  • Strong SQL skills.You can read and write SQL,validate data, and trace where a number comes from.
  • Experience defining KPIs with Finance and other business owners.
  • Experience with data models, data quality, or data governance.
  • A good understanding of data flows, pipelines, and transformations.
  • Confidence working with senior stakeholders and challenging unclear or incorrect numbers.
  • A hands-on, business-minded approach. You connect business questions with practical data solutions.
  • Experience with automation, AI Agents, or AI-supported workflows.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, German is a plus.
Nice to have 
  • Experience with Metabase, dbt, AWS Glue, Spark, Airbyte, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with workshops, enablement, or data literacy programmes.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, EV charging, energy, mobility, or a related field.
You do not need every tool on the list. We care most about strong SQL, sound data thinking, and the ability to bring people to one shared definition.


What you can expect from us

How we work 
Clear goals, real ownership, and little politics. We move quickly, decide together, and hold each other accountable.
 
Where you will work 
Our Munich office at Stiglmaierplatz is an important place for collaboration. For this role, we expect at least three days on-site each week. 

What you get 

  • 28 vacation days - Plus additional days off between Christmas and New Year. Good work starts with proper rest.
  • Mental health, taken seriously - Free access to the nilo platform with individual sessions from psychologists and business coaches. We want you balanced, not just productive.
  • AI tools - no limits - Every person and every team at reev uses the AI tools they choose, without budget constraints. We believe in working with the best tools available, and we don't slow that down.
  • Move sustainably - JobRad, subsidised public transport, or EGYM Wellpass. You choose what fits your life.
  • €1,000 learning budget -Yours to use. Plus internal development opportunities. Because when you grow, we all grow.
  • Your future, sorted - Digital, commission-free company pension (bAV) with DYNO. Transparent, with a personal dashboard. No fineprint.

title: Data Protection & AI Governance Advisor (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at neoshare
description_html:
Your mission

Datenschutz 

  • Du unterstützt unsere Business Funktionen bei der Dokumentation ihrer Verarbeitungsprozessen und pflegst die Verzeichnisse nach Art. 30 Abs. 1 + 2 DSGVO.
  • Du erstellst Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen, Legitimate Interest Assessments und Transfer Impact Assessments.
  • Du berätst die Fachbereiche zur datenschutzrechtlichen Ausgestaltung unserer SaaS-Produkte und internen Prozesse – insbesondere zu Datenminimierung, Mandantentrennung, Berechtigungskonzepten, Löschung und Privacy by Design.
  • Du prüfst Auftragsverarbeitungsverträge und führst Vorabprüfungen neuer Dienstleister und KI-Tools durch.
  • Du betreibst das Datenschutzmanagementsystem: Du pflegst Richtlinien und Vorlagen, führst Kontrollen durch, überwachst Abhilfemaßnahmen und verwaltest unsere Datenschutz- und KI-Governanceplattform.
 
AI Governance 
  • Du baust das Inventar unserer KI-Systeme auf und pflegst es, bereitest die Einordnung nach Art. 6 und Anhang III AI Act vor und bestimmst unsere Rolle als Anbieter oder Betreiber.
  • Du wirkst am Freigabeprozess für KI-Vorhaben mit und entwickelst Prüfkriterien, Gates und Entscheidungsvorlagen.
  • Du erstellst die Pflichtdokumentation zu Risikomanagement, Daten-Governance und Bias-Prüfung, technischer Dokumentation, menschlicher Aufsicht, Protokollierung sowie Transparenzpflichten.
  • Du prüfst KI-Modelle und -Dienste auf vertragliche Zusagen zu Trainingsnutzung, Datenhaltung und Vereinbarkeit mit unseren Kundenzusagen.
 
So arbeiten wir zusammen 
  • Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, schlagkräftigen Teams, das pragmatisch denkt und eng mit Produkt, Engineering und Legal zusammenarbeitet. Wir schätzen offenen Austausch, kurze Wege und die gemeinsame Freude daran, komplexe Regulatorik in praktikable Lösungen zu übersetzen.


Your profile

  • Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Datenschutz mit, davon substanziell in einer Second-Line-Funktion – etwa als Datenschutzkoordinator, im Datenschutzmanagement, in einer Compliance- oder Governance-Einheit oder in einer externen Beratungsrolle mit vergleichbarem Prüfauftrag.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzungen, Legitimate Interest Assessments und Transfer Impact Assessments.
  • Du gehst sicher mit der DSGVO auf Normebene um, kennst die EDSA-Leitlinien und bist vertraut mit der Rechtsprechung zu Drittlandtransfers und Verantwortlichkeit.
  • Du hast erste belegbare Berührungspunkte mit KI-Governance und dem EU AI Act – etwa durch Klassifizierung von KI-Systemen, Bewertung von LLM-gestützten Funktionen, Modell- oder Bias-Prüfungen, Erstellung von Transparenzhinweisen oder Mitarbeit an einer KI-Richtlinie. Du musst keine vollständige AI-Act-Routine mitbringen; die Bereitschaft, dir diese Tiefe bei uns aufzubauen, genügt uns.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und verlässlich mit hoher Sorgfalt in der Dokumentation.
  • Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.
Wünschenswert: Du hast ein juristisches Studium abgeschlossen sowie eine Zertifizierung wie etwa IAPP CIPP/E, CIPM oder AIGP erworben. 
Für Juristinnen und Juristen: Du strebst eine Zulassung als Syndikusrechtsanwältin oder Syndikusrechtsanwalt an? Wir unterstützen dich aktiv dabei – sowohl im Zulassungsverfahren als auch bei der fachlichen Ausgestaltung deiner Rolle.

description_html:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE
  • Au sein de la Direction de la Communication, vous intégrerez le pôle Communication Interne & Éditorial de Veepee. Vous serez plus particulièrement chargé(e) de contribuer à la valorisation des initiatives liées aux collaborateurs, qu’il s’agisse d’informations clés RH, de programmes internes, d’actions de développement, ou encore de projets transverses portant sur l’engagement, la culture d’entreprise et la RSE.
    •  
  • Accompagné(e) d’une cheffe de projet, vous prendrez en autonomie un périmètre de communications internes à forte dimension “collaborateurs”, en lien avec différents interlocuteurs métiers (dont les équipes RH), tout en participant à la mise en place d’événements et d’actions internes.
    •  
  • Votre rôle mêlera coordination, production éditoriale, création visuelle et gestion opérationnelle de projets

    • 🎯 MISSIONS
  • 1. Gestion d’un périmètre de communication interne orienté “initiatives collaborateurs”
  • Structurer et accompagner les besoins de communication sur les sujets liés à la vie interne : programmes, informations clés, actualités, dispositifs collaborateurs…
  • Collecter et formaliser les briefs auprès des équipes concernées (People, développement interne, learning, engagement…).
  • Rédiger et diffuser les contenus sur les canaux internes :e-mails, posts Slack, articles intranet, communications visuelles de messages pédagogiques ou informatifs diffusés sur les écrans dynamiques.
  • Assurer la cohérence éditoriale et proposer des formats adaptés selon les audiences.
    •  
  • 2. Coordination & gestion de projets transverses (RSE, engagement, culture d’entreprise)
  • Participer à la conception et à l’animation d’actions internes : moments forts RSE, Marronnier RH, campagnes de sensibilisation, initiatives d’engagement, projets menés avec le Fonds Veepee.
  • Gérer les aspects opérationnels de communication : planning, coordination des parties prenantes, suivi logistique et diffusion.
    •  
  • 3. Création de contenus & design
  • Concevoir des supports visuels variés : infographies, visuels pour écrans, bannières, mini-guides, éléments pour l’intranet…
  • Décliner des messages en formats visuels adaptés, principalement via Canva.
  • Veiller à la cohérence graphique avec l’identité visuelle de Veepee.

    • 👉 MUST HAVE SKILLS
  • Étudiant(e) en Bac+4/5 en communication / RH, école de commerce  ou formation équivalente.
  • Intérêt marqué pour la communication interne, la vie d’entreprise et les projets à impact collaborateurs (développement RH, engagement, inclusion, culture…).
  • Excellente plume et capacité à vulgariser des sujets variés.
  • Très bonne maîtrise de Canva, et/ou d’outils de PAO.
  • Organisation, rigueur, sens des priorités et autonomie.
  • Aisance relationnelle : coordination, prise de briefs, interactions régulières avec divers métiers.
  • Créatif(ve), curieux(se), force de proposition et à l’aise avec les outils digitaux.
  • Anglais courant indispensable.

    • ✅ BENEFITS
  • 👉Bureau flexible avec au minimum 3 jours sur place et jusqu'à 2 jours à domicile
  • 👉Plate-forme d'apprentissage des langues en ligne
  • 👉Comité d’entreprise CE et ses nombreux avantages
  • 👉Accès à une restauration d'entreprise et cantine connecté
  • 👉Accès à la Salle de sport
  • 👉Congés selon la durée du contrat

    • ⚙️RECRUITMENT PROCESS

title: AI Engineer Intern, GenAI Internal Automation (GAIA)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Equativ
description_html:
About the team

At Equativ, we're on a mission to develop advertising technologies that empower our customers to reach their digital business goals. The impact of Generative AI on the industry is projected to be major, and Equativ has been undergoing a significant transformation to embed this technology at the core of our value proposition.

The GenAI team is a new, strategic unit (6–8 people) responsible for the design, development, and deployment of Equativ's entire GenAI stack. You will be joining a team of 3 developers and 2 product managers. It is split into two complementary pillars:

  • Core Platform — designing and building a reusable, industrialized Agentic Platform (MaaS, AaaS, Model/Agent as a Service) to accelerate agent development across the company.

  • Business Feature — the team you will be joining. We develop and deploy mission-critical AI agents that automate workflows for non-technical internal teams (operations, ad quality, marketplace, finance support, etc.). Our backlog targets people who today rely on manual processes and ad-hoc tooling, your work will give them autonomous, measurable, production-grade AI assistants.

This team is part of the R&D department (200+ engineers across Paris, Nantes, Limoges, Krakow, Berlin and North America), all working in an Agile environment.


What you will do

  • Create reusable components and libraries (Python + n8n) for the Business Feature Team, leveraging existing workflows and agents to accelerate future development.

  • Perform maintenance (TMA) on existing workflows and agents, focusing on resolving issues and improving performance.

  • Partner directly with non-technical stakeholders, sit with operations teams, understand their pain points, translate workflows into agentic solutions, and explain your design choices.

  • Collaborate with the team on Python development, contributing to the production codebase by applying software engineering principles (unit tests, CI/CD, Git, code review) and helping implement AIOps/AgentOps best practices.


About you

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or similar technical fields.

  • Experience with Python, and using Git for collaboration. You are comfortable working in group projects and collaborating within a team, with a strong desire to learn AIOps/MLOps best practices in a professional environment.

  • Proven experience building production-ready agent workflows with Google ADK (strongly preferred), Langchain, or LangGraph.

  • Practical experience with cloud platforms (Vertex AI, Kubernetes or equivalents) for deploying scalable GenAI services.

  • You can sit down with a non-technical stakeholder, draw out their workflow, and come back with a working agent.

  • Versatile, autonomous, and proactive, you love taking initiatives and driving your projects, with a strong desire to grow while being mentored by our solid team of developers and product managers.

  • Fluent technical English (written and verbal) mandatory.


Practical

  • Status: Internship

  • Location: Paris

  • Working language: English

👋 About us 

Equativ, a leading independent ad platform, brings scale and simplicity to digital advertising.
 
Following its recent merger with Sharethrough and the acquisition of Kamino Retail, advertisers, media owners, and technology partners rely on Equativ’s advanced SSP, curation, and retail media services and technology to achieve maximum business outcomes.
 
With a focus on privacy-first programmatic video, CTV, and data-driven solutions, Equativ enables clients to activate across the digital ecosystem while protecting consumer privacy.
 
The company’s global expertise is also backed by a team of over 750 employees across 19 countries.
 
As a proud recipient of the HappyIndex@Work label, Equativ is committed to providing a dynamic, flexible workplace where employees thrive, grow, and excel in both their professional and personal lives.
Come and lead the charge with us in building a transparent ecosystem based on quality!

title: Endear - Product Designer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Eleve Talent
description_html:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

title: Senior Customer Success Consultant
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Avomind
description_html:
Our client is a European HR software company that is expanding rapidly in Germany, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 they 𝐰𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 them.

Their mission is simple: they design intuitive solutions that automate HR and administrative processes, giving thousands of companies across Europe more time and energy for what really matters : their people and their business.

With 800+ experts based in Germany, France, Spain and Switzerland, and 8,700 clients across 𝟏𝟒𝟎+ 𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐬, they’re building on a strong foundation while accelerating their international footprint, driving forward with an 𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐮𝐚𝐥 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐭𝐡 𝐨𝐟 𝟒𝟎%.


Your role

In order to continue their expansion in this market, they are looking for a Senior HRIS Customer Success Consultant to join our growing team in Germany.

Your missions will evolve as you acquire seniority, but here are the main tasks you will do on a daily basis:

𝐂𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐧𝐛𝐨𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 (𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐣𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐢𝐦𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧)
- Roll out the solutions for a wide variety of customers in often complex and high-stakes environments (SME as well as Large Accounts).
- Gain the trust of local companies in Germany as well as key accounts and their subsidiaries abroad.
- Gather the customer's initial needs and suggest an appropriate response.
- Adapt the software to the customer’s local context in Germany.
- Train the administrators to use the software in total autonomy.
- Ensure the Go-live and the follow-up during the first weeks of use.
- Demonstrate flexibility and agility throughout the implementation in the event of unforeseen circumstances and technical challenges.

𝐅𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐨𝐰-𝐮𝐩 𝐨𝐟 𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐀𝐜𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐬 (𝐬𝐮𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭, 𝐚𝐜𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭 𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭)
- Keep a close eye on the satisfaction of your most important customers.
- Support these customers in case of level 2 issues.
- Carry out post-implementation check-ups.
- Identify and generate new cross sell or upsell opportunities to grow the company's reach to your German customers (lead generation).
- Be proactive in presenting new products that may address a customer's past issues.

𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐛𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐨𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐳𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐮𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐢𝐦𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐒 𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐢𝐧 the company
- Adapt their offer and strengthen the market-fit of their solutions for the German market.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of the business in Germany by going beyond your main tasks.
- Follow and participate in some projects from the pre-sales phase, supporting the sales team.

Requirements

Sounds a bit like you, doesn't it?

You’re the right fit if you:
❏ You have prior experience in a project management role (at least 4-5 years).
❏ You have a Tech / SaaS affinity. You have successfully led end-to-end software implementation projects, coordinating internal teams and client stakeholders across all phases.
❏ You don’t need prior HR knowledge, but it would be a plus.
❏ A willingness to be a key player in this adventure, contributing to the German market's growth.
❏ Looking for a dynamic work environment with varied missions requiring versatility and organization.
❏ Comfortable and eager to work with both local businesses and key accounts (C-Level).
❏ You speak German at a native level and you have a strong command of English.
❏ Clear and structured oral and written communication.
❏ Taste for human contact and pedagogy.
❏ An aptitude for solving practical and sometimes technical problems.
❏ A sense of service and a taste for things well done.

And now, their recruitment process (in German and in English):

𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟏: Screening interview with HR (30')
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟐: Interview with the Customer Success Manager (60')
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟑: Case study + quick chat with team members
𝐒𝐭𝐞𝐩 𝟒: Final Talk (45'): meet more of the team and see what the company is all about

Benefits

🚆 Deutschlandticket – 75% of your subscription covered.
🏋️‍♀️ Wellpass subscription – discounted access to sports, fitness and activities you actually enjoy.
🐾 Their office is pet-friendly! Feel free to bring your furry friends to work.
🏠 Remote-friendly work policy– remote work possible after onboarding, either occasional or hybrid. To make working from home comfortable, the company provides the right equipment.

Their 𝐜𝐮𝐥𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞

At our client's company, they have just one rule: work seriously, but don’t take yourself too seriously. They value transparency, autonomy, high standards, and a free spirit so everyone can give their best while staying true to themselves.

And because work should also be fun, their year is full of events: several company seminars, a team-building activity per team, a start-up weekend, a welcome drink every month for new hires, and introductory lunches for newcomers. They love coming together, sharing, and celebrating… So, are you ready to join them?

title: Working Student Application Software Engineer

description_html:
We are Isarsoft

We make every camera count
At ​Isarsoft ​we develop video analytics software ​to make transportation and cities more efficient, inclusive and secure. ​We stand for data protection and responsible processing of sensitive data. Being ​on the forefront of innovation we work together in interdisciplinary teams in a positive, fun and energetic atmosphere.

Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do. ​Founded in 2019 ​​we have ​grown organically winning large customers ​and partners delivering compelling, reliable, high-performance software. We are proud of being a privately held company with family atmosphere focusing on long-term relations to our customers and team members.


Your mission

  • Support Customer Success: Assist in engaging with customers to understand their technical needs and use cases for Isarsoft Perception.

  • Bridge Tech & Requirements: Work alongside our engineering team to help translate customer feedback into actionable product requirements.

  • Hands-on Technical Support: Partner with sales and engineering teams during technical workshops, product demos, and onboarding.

  • Product Improvement: Help investigate new feature opportunities based on real user data and customer feedback.


Your profile

  • Enrolled student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (ideally with at least 2 semesters remaining).

  • First practical experience (through projects, internships, or courses) in SQL, Python, and working with APIs/SDKs.

  • Strong communication skills and a problem-solving mindset with a focus on helping users.

  • Fluency in both English and German (min. C1 level required).

  • Ability to work up to 20 hours/week during the semester (flexible during semester breaks).


Additional assets

  • Familiarity with Docker or Linux environments.

  • Basic understanding of Computer Vision or AI applications.

  • Prior experience in a startup or fast-paced tech environment

  • Modern development workflow proficiency, including the confident and reliable use of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor).

  • Strong foundation in version control systems (Git) and hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines


Benefits

  • An experienced, highly motivated and international team to learn and grow
  • A high-impact work environment with flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes
  • Have the flexibility to work from anywhere: A great office in Munich, from home or the English-Garden
  • Free lunch, coffee and drinks at our office 
Sounds good? We are just getting started. Let's build a great company together.


Hiring Process

We are committed to a transparent and fair hiring process. We aim for concluding the interview process in no longer than 2 weeks.

The following three stages are typical for any position at Isarsoft.

  • Video Interview with HR
  • Technical Deep Dive 
We deeply believe that a great product only can be build by a great team. That's why sharing our values, being a team-player and having a energetic attitude is as important as bringing the right technical skills.

title: Robotics Software Engineer Intern – Swarm Systems (m/f/d)

description_html:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile team building autonomous robotic systems
  • Contribute to software that is tested on real robotic platforms and in the field
  • Gain hands-on experience with state-of-the-art technologies in robotics, autonomy, and multi-agent systems
  • Work closely with experienced robotics and embedded engineers
  • Take ownership of meaningful technical projects while receiving guidance from the team
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and a collaborative engineering culture


Your mission

Join our robotics team working on autonomous systems that operate as coordinated, distributed agents in real-world environments. 

As a Software Engineering Intern, you will contribute to the development and validation of our multi-UAV system, with a particular focus on software tooling, simulation, and system observability. 

Depending on your background and the project, you may also contribute to areas such as SLAM, navigation, perception, planning, or multi-agent coordination. This is a hands-on internship where you will develop and test software, work with real robotic systems, and see how your work performs beyond simulation. 

  • Develop data-driven dashboards and tools to monitor, analyze, and visualize system performance
  • Extend our simulation framework with KPIs, automated scenarios, and evaluation workflows
  • Analyze simulation and field-test data to identify issues and opportunities for improvement
  • Contribute to the core robotics stack in areas such as estimation, perception, planning, control, or mission execution
  • Collaborate closely with robotics, simulation, embedded, and domain experts
  • Gain practical experience developing and validating software for complex autonomous systems


Your profile

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Autonomous Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
  • Good programming skills in C++, ideally modern C++ (17/20)
  • Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and software engineering
  • Basic understanding of robotics concepts such as coordinate frames, sensor data, estimation, planning, or control
  • Comfortable working in Linux
  • Curious about complex roboticsystems and motivated to understand how things work beyond your individual component
  • Able to work independently on a defined technical problem while actively seeking feedback when needed
  • Genuine interest in autonomous systems, robotics, and defense technology


Nice to have

You do not need to bring all of these — experience from university projects, research, student teams, personal projects, or previous internships counts. 

  • Experience with ROS or ROS 2
  • Experience with real robots, embedded systems, or hardware-in-the-loop setups
  • Exposure to SLAM, navigation, computer vision, estimation, filtering, planning, or control
  • Interest or experience in multi-agent systems, swarming, or distributed robotics
  • Experience working with LiDAR or camera data
  • Exposure to PX4 or ArduPilot
  • Experience with simulation frameworks such as Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or Unreal Engine
  • Experience with embedded platforms, GPUs, or networking
  • Exposure to machine learning methods


What else

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn
  • Structured and reliable way of working
  • Comfortable working in an environment where not every problem has a predefined solution
  • Collaborative and open to technical feedback
  • High ethical standards and disciplined workethic
  • Extra-curricular engineering projects, robotics competitions, research, or other technical achievements are a plus

The practical part 

  • Duration: 3–6 months, full-time
  • Eligibility: NATO-aligned nationality or close ally citizenship is required

title: Principal Engineer - Autonomous Systems (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at autonomous-teaming
description_html:
What we offer

  • Work in an international, agile and ambitious team creating the future of autonomous systems
  • Grow your career in a expanding and ambitious engineering team
  • Build innovative products using state-of-the-art technologies in AI, robotics, and autonomy 
  • Benefit from a steep learning curve and continuous development
  • Enjoy team events and a strong, collaborative culture


Your mission

Join Autonomous Teaming Solutions and build next-generation autonomous robotic systems for demanding real-world environments. You will take end-to-end technical ownership and responsibility of a mission-critical robotics product where perception, system performance, and reliability directly impact operational success. 

As Principal Engineer, you carry overall technical responsibility. You have the final word on architecture, integration and deployment - and you carry the consequences when the system fails. No project manager above you. You decide, you deliver. You work directly with company leadership, not as a career step, but because you are the deepest technically. Your place is still in the team: building, not reporting.

  • You own a complex autonomous system end-to-end - from architecture to field deployment.
  • You build yourself solutions - every day, in the code, next to your team. With us, leading means going first.
  • You are the tiebreaker on technical decisions across all subsystems.
  • You cut whatever does not pay into the next milestone - before you optimize.
  • You test in the field, with measurable and clear pass/fail criteria.


Your profile

  • You are a builder. You have already put things into the world. Systems, products, projects with real users. Not just planned, not conceptualized: built.
  • You have built something of your own before: a company, a product, a project with no one standing behind you. You know what real responsibility feels like. 
  • Deep knowledge in real-time embedded systems, sensor fusion or perception. Proven by systems that run and make a difference. 
  • You have taken something from zero to running hard- and software solutions. Solely responsible, with numbers to show for it.
  • C++ and ROS2 under a latency budget is your terrain.
  • Your first reaction to a new requirement is to ask whether it can be dropped.
  • You have made engineers better by building next to them and coach them.
  • You build in your own time too, because you cannot do otherwise.


What else

  • Citizenship of a NATO member country or close ally.


Why us?

How we work

Clear ownership, everything else is bureaucracy. Every system has exactly one owner with the final word. No V-model, no phase gates, no sign-off meetings. Requirements get challenged, not worked through. Delete first, then simplify, then accelerate - in that order.

Our milestones are binary. Testing happens in the field, not in simulation.


What you get
  • Full technical authority over a system in active deployment.
  • Direct contact with the customer, no layers in between.
  • A team that owns the mission itself.
  • Munich, 5 days on-site. We build together.

No job for you if
  • You need three meetings before a decision gets made.
  • You want a title. What we hand out is the final word and full consequence.
  • A good design matters more to you than a running, functional system.

title: Embedded Software & Systems Consultant (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Invensity Group
description_html:
Welcome

Are you passionate about embedded software, industrial communication, and intelligent drive systems? Then join INVENSITY. Together with our customers, we develop innovative solutions for the next generation of industrial control and drive technologies and actively drive the digital transformation of industry.

Your contribution: You’ll develop and optimize software for modern controller platforms, variable-frequency drives, and servo drives. With your expertise in real-time communication, embedded systems, and industrial networks, you’ll lay the foundation for high-performance, reliable, and future-proof automation solutions.



What can you expect?

  • Help shape the next generation of intelligent IoT solutions by developing innovative software for open communication protocols and TSN (Time-Sensitive Networking) technologies on new and existing embedded platforms
  • Bring together various technologies by integrating, validating, and continuously optimizing third-party software components and modern communication stacks
  • Work in a modern, agile development environment based on model-driven methods, which gives you the opportunity to help shape holistic solutions that go beyond individual embedded platforms
  • Take on responsibility as part of a dedicated, agile team and actively contribute to the development of high-performance, reliable, and high-quality software products
  • Benefit from collaborating in interdisciplinary and international teams, exchange ideas with experts from a wide range of disciplines, and help shape innovative technologies in a global environment
  • Personal and professional development: Grow in a technologically leading environment, build connections, and help drive innovation across a wide variety of industries


Your profile

  • A successfully completed degree in computer science, electrical engineering, communications and information technology, or a comparable field
  • Several years of professional experience in hardware-oriented embedded software development using C/C++ under real-time operating systems (RTOS), as well as in-depth knowledge of Python and Git-based development environments
  • In-depth knowledge of Ethernet-based communication protocols such as TCP/IP, TLS, and PTP; ideally supplemented by experience with industry standards such as IEEE 1588, TSN, and X.509
  • Knowledge of C#, SQL, GoogleTest, and Jenkins, as well as experience with Azure DevOps/Pipelines, Visual Studio Code, or modern CI/CD processes, is a plus
  • Strong conceptual and analytical skills, as well as the ability to communicate complex technical issues to various stakeholders in a way that is tailored to their needs, understandable, and practical
  • Business-level proficiency in German and very good English skills




What are your benefits?

  • Structured onboarding: A clear onboarding plan, joint starting days with other new employees, and dedicated contact persons will support you from day one
  • Flexible working: Permanent employment contracts, flexible working hours, the option to work from home, part-time arrangements, and sabbatical opportunities
  • Global network: Collaboration with experts across our international locations
  • A unique working atmosphere and an appreciative corporate culture: Monthly office events, a first-name culture, short communication channels, and working towards shared goals
  • A steep learning curve: Varied responsibilities in an innovative environment, with diverse projects across different industries and clients
  • Personal and professional development: Individual mentoring and coaching, ACADEMY training courses, and an open feedback culture
  • Attractive career opportunities: Transparent career paths, the opportunity to take on responsibility quickly, and international career prospects
  • Performance-based compensation package: Fixed and variable salary components as well as assessments every six months




Good to know

Employment type: Permanent employment
Work model: Hybrid, combining remote work and office-based work
Workplace: Mannheim or Heidelberg


Your contact person

Sinja Seyfert

title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Schiller International University
description_html:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.

description_html:
Bei Eneto machen wir moderne Klimaanlagen- und Heizlösungen schnell, einfach und bezahlbar zugänglich. Mit hochwertigen Markenprodukten, klaren Prozessen und transparenten Festpreisen kommen Kunden ohne Aufwand zur optimalen Lösung. Über 70.000 Kundenerfahrungen aus früheren Energieprojekten bilden unsere Basis. Unser Marketingteam ist klein, bewegt aber viel – und genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der nicht wartet, bis ihm etwas gesagt wird, sondern selbst denkt, anpackt und mitgestaltet. Wer Verantwortung übernehmen will, bekommt sie bei uns.

Aufgaben

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern an strategischen und operativen Themen, die gerade anstehen – von Produkt über Business Development bis Marketing.
  • Du übernimmst eigene Projekte entlang der Wachstumshebel: neue Vertriebskanäle aufbauen, Partnerschaften anbahnen, Prozesse aufsetzen, Angebote schärfen.
  • Du analysierst, wo wir Hebel haben, leitest Hypothesen ab und testest sie – ob im Funnel, im Produkt oder im Vertrieb.
  • Du recherchierst Märkte, Wettbewerber und Kooperationsmöglichkeiten und bereitest Entscheidungen vor.
  • Du springst dort ein, wo es brennt – im jungen Unternehmen heißt das: heute Partnergespräche vorbereiten, morgen eine Landingpage konzipieren, übermorgen einen Prozess aufsetzen.
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein – und siehst, was daraus wird.

Qualifikation

  • Du bist immatrikuliert (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Marketing o. Ä.) und hast 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit.
  • Erste Erfahrungen im Unternehmensumfeld – ob durch Praktika, eigene Projekte, Studenteninitiativen oder Nebenjobs.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du verstehst schnell, worauf es ankommt, und priorisierst nach Wirkung.
  • Analytische Denkweise und Spaß daran, Hypothesen mit Daten zu prüfen.
  • Hohe Eigeninitiative und Hands-on-Mentalität: Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben, sondern bringst dich aktiv ein.
  • Strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise – auch remote.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift.
  • Nice to have: Interesse an Energie oder Wärmepumpen-/Klimaanlagen-Themen.

Benefits

  • Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Gründern – lerne direkt von Unternehmern, die bereits ein Unternehmen auf 30 Mio. € skaliert haben
  • Breiter Lernhorizont – du siehst, wie ein Unternehmen wirklich aufgebaut wird, statt nur in einer Funktion zu sitzen.
  • Kleines Team, große Wirkung – kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten – passend zu deinem Stundenplan.
  • Remote-Setup – du brauchst nur Laptop und Internetzugang.
  • Übernahmeperspektive – wer liefert und reinpasst, bekommt die Chance, dauerhaft Teil des Teams zu werden.

Mit hochwertigen Markenprodukten, klaren Prozessen und transparenten Festpreisen kommen Kunden ohne Aufwand zur optimalen Lösung. Über 70.000 Kundenerfahrungen aus früheren Energieprojekten bilden unsere Basis. Unser Marketingteam ist klein, bewegt aber viel – und genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der nicht wartet, bis ihm etwas gesagt wird, sondern selbst denkt, anpackt und mitgestaltet. Wer Verantwortung übernehmen will, bekommt sie bei uns. 
 Aufgaben 
 
 Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern an strategischen und operativen Themen, die gerade anstehen – von Produkt über Business Development bis Marketing. 
 Du übernimmst eigene Projekte entlang der Wachstumshebel: neue Vertriebskanäle aufbauen, Partnerschaften anbahnen, Prozesse aufsetzen, Angebote schärfen. 
 Du analysierst, wo wir Hebel haben, leitest Hypothesen ab und testest sie – ob im Funnel, im Produkt oder im Vertrieb. 
 Du recherchierst Märkte, Wettbewerber und Kooperationsmöglichkeiten und bereitest Entscheidungen vor. 
 Du springst dort ein, wo es brennt – im jungen Unternehmen heißt das: heute Partnergespräche vorbereiten, morgen eine Landingpage konzipieren, übermorgen einen Prozess aufsetzen. 
 Du bringst eigene Ideen ein – und siehst, was daraus wird.

 Du bist immatrikuliert (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Marketing o. Ä.) und hast 20 Stunden pro Woche Zei

title: Senior Global HR Business Partner (m/f/d)

description_html:
Transform with us the future of energy ⚡

The SGB‑SMIT Group is an international transformer manufacturer with locations in Europe, Asia and the United States. With reliable transformer technology, the company actively supports the global energy transition in areas such as renewable energy, industry and urban energy infrastructure.

As a key link between power generation, transmission and distribution, SGB‑SMIT Group develops and manufactures power transformers, distribution transformers, cast‑resin transformers and custom solutions for data centers, industrial applications and e‑mobility. These products ensure efficient, stable and secure energy flows worldwide.

With more than 3,800 employees worldwide, the SGB‑SMIT Group stands for quality, innovation and sustainability and offers a stable environment to work on technologies that shape the energy systems of the future.

What sets the SGB-SMIT Group apart: 🌍

We combine the strength of an international technology company with an employee-oriented corporate culture:

  • Meaningful work at the heart of the energy transition

  • Short decision-making processes and direct cooperation

  • Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

Your contribution counts – both professionally and personally.

Your benefits at SGB-SMIT Group: 🚀

  • Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

  • Attractive salary and social benefits

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working models

  • 30+1 vacation days plus special leave

  • Training and development opportunities

  • Company pension plan and employee insurance

  • Health and fitness offers (HanseFit)

  • Company restaurant, free drinks, and e-charging parking spaces

  • Bicycle and IT leasing

  • Subsidy for Germany/RVV ticket

  • Employee discounts via Benify

Your tasks: 📌

  • Strategic consulting and support for international business units and local HR organizations on all HR-related issues in a global context

  • Leading and implementing group-wide HR projects and transformation initiatives, e.g., in the areas of organizational development, talent management, performance management, and compensation & benefits

  • Developing, harmonizing, and implementing global HR strategies, standards, processes, and guidelines to support corporate objectives

  • Management of international organizational and change management projects, as well as support for integration and growth initiatives

  • Analysis of global HR metrics, and the development and implementation of sustainable measures to increase employee retention, organizational effectiveness, and talent development

  • Coordination and management of collaboration with regional HR teams and relevant corporate functions to ensure a consistent global HR approach

Your profile: 🔎

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, business administration, business law, psychology, or a comparable qualification

  • Several years of professional experience as an HR Business Partner, HR Manager, or in a comparable strategic HR role in an international environment

  • Extensive experience in leading and implementing global HR projects and transformation initiatives

  • A strong understanding of international HR processes as well as collaboration with diverse cultures and stakeholders

  • Experience advising Leadership and collaborating with regional HR teams and corporate functions

  • Strong analytical and conceptual skills, as well as a structured, independent, and solution-oriented approach to work

  • High level of communication, consulting, and project management skills, as well as the ability to successfully manage change

  • Excellent written and spoken German and English skills

If you value a dynamic, growing, and intercultural environment and enjoy hands-on work, then become part of the SGB-SMIT Group - transform with us the future of energy. ⚡

We look forward to receiving your application! ⚡

Learn more about the SGB-SMIT Group as an employer, our values, and career opportunities on our careers page:

https://www.sgb-smit.com/career-jobs/sgb-smit-group#/

The terms used in this text refer to all genders in accordance with the General Equal Treatment Act (AGG).

title: Managing Director
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Valsoft Corp
description_html:
Description

Valsoft specialises in acquiring and growing vertical market software companies. Our mission is to provide a permanent home for software businesses, preserving the legacy of their founders while investing in the long-term growth and success of the companies we acquire. We operate and manage a global portfolio of wholly owned software businesses, delivering mission-critical solutions across multiple verticals. By implementing industry best practices, Valsoft ensures a time-sensitive integration process and operates a decentralised model, fostering rapid growth through reinvestment in its portfolio.   

The Role:   

This position provides critical operational leadership to a company and potentially a portfolio of companies within a growing software vertical. As the leader of a company, you will be responsible for developing and implementing the business’s strategic plan across all major functions, including sales and marketing, R&D, customer service, professional services, and human resources.   

You will work closely with the leadership team to identify, define, and execute strategies required to achieve growth plans and operating objectives, with a focus on improving operational excellence. This role carries full accountability for the company's results, making it ideal for a driven leader eager to make a significant impact.   

Key Responsibilities:   

  • Own the long-range, annual, and quarterly financial and non-financial goals  
  • Develop and communicate a clear vision of goals and objectives, strategies, and philosophies about growth, revenue generation, profitability, and customer care  
  • Manage day-to-day operations, including sales performance, opportunity management, forecasting, R&D capacity, and customer support  
  • Attend promotional events which include but not limited to tradeshows and panels  

Sales and Marketing   

  • Drive revenue growth, working with the sales team to identify new opportunities and execute growth strategies including cross/upsell and entering adjacent markets     
  • Develop and implement best in class sales operations and sales infrastructure to enable effective scale and ensure process discipline     
  • Develop and maintain competitive intelligence programs, generating industry trend reports to inform new feature and product development    
  • Improve use of Salesforce and other internal tools to increase forecasting capability, implement targets, and provide actionable insights to executive team and board of directors    
  • Create and implement KPIs for sales team to measure performance and productivity (ex: CAC / LTV) ; develop performance dashboards and establish reporting process (measure NRR and MRR trends)    
  • Work with sales leaders in establishing quotas, budgets, compensation plans and pricing optimization    
  • Manage key relationships with large accounts is mandatory    

Customer Care/Customer Success:  

  • Execute an effective, long-term customer success program for clients    
  • Implement and maintain client support initiatives    
  • Facilitate both in-house and client training sessions    
  • Monitor and document Customer Success metrics, including program usage, satisfaction levels, ticket throughput, and resolution    
  • Coordinate the administration of annual customer satisfaction surveys (NPS) and other communication tools    

Research and Development:    

  • Ensure clear product roadmaps are established, followed, and adapted to meet market needs    
  • Balance investment in R&D with maintenance efforts to maximize new customer growth and retain existing clients while maintaining efficient Customer Care and R&D operations    
  • Track Product Manager prioritization of R&D tasks, ensuring they are entered into the corporate system and executed by software developers    
  • Facilitate the growth of Product Managers by aligning their activities with job descriptions    

Professional services:    

  • Ensure we are delivering profitable projects by monitoring billable utilizations, staff OPEX and contribution margin    
  • Establish strategies to increase NRR    
  • Track on a monthly basis results with the Head of Professional Services    

Financial Management:    

  • Review with Senior Management and the team:    
  • Advance performance by driving improvements in revenue, profit, customer retention, loss prevention, and expense ratios    
  • Annual, quarterly, and monthly revenue results/forecasts and costs    
  • Participate in the development of internal department policies and programs to support quality and growth    
  • Drive P&L, ROI, EBITDA, rule of 40 and ARR/ IRR performance of businesses and ensure companies are meeting organizational objectives    

Human resources:    

  • Partnering with your HR lead in driving talent retention and development, complying with local employment legislation and developing a true local company culture   

Growth through M&A:  

  • Engage in M&A activities, working closely with the Valsoft investment group on acquisition strategy and M&A initiatives  
  • Oversee post-acquisition initiatives to integrate companies into your business, focusing on operational transformation and implementation of efficiencies  

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Proven experience in senior leadership roles within the software or technology sector
  • Strong skills in developing and executing strategic business plans across multiple functions
  • Demonstrated success in driving revenue growth and market expansion
  • Hands-on approach to managing daily operations and improving operational excellence
  • Proven track record in leading change management initiatives — bringing teams through restructuring, process redesign, or new ways of working with clarity and buy-in
  • Practical understanding of AI and its application to software products and internal operations, with the ability to translate emerging technology into concrete business value and to drive adoption across the organisation
  • Exceptional leadership with the ability to inspire and manage cross-functional teams through periods of transformation
  • Results-oriented with a focus on achieving targets and continuous improvement
  • Strong commitment to customer success and care
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for influencing stakeholders and building support for change at all levels
  • Innovative, proactive, and adaptable with a collaborative mindset
  • Full professional proficiency in English (required)
  • Legally authorized to work in Germany / Switzerland / Austria / France

  

 #HeliosSoftware

title: Tech Advisory Senior Consultant (m/w/d)

description_html:
YOUR TASKS

As a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) in the Tech Advisory area, you will take on a key role in complex transformation projects. You will support our clients in the digital and organizational evolution of their business models and processes - from strategy development through to operational implementation.
You will work at the intersection of business, technology, and change management, applying agile methodologies in a targeted and effective way. In transformation projects, you will play a central role by bringing structure, clarity, and strong execution capabilities.

Your responsibilities will include a wide range of tasks:

  • Supporting transformation initiatives: Assisting clients in the structured development and optimization of organizations, processes, and ways of working
  • Interface management between business and IT: Gathering, structuring, and aligning business requirements while ensuring a shared understanding of project objectives
  • (Partial) project management: Independently planning, coordinating, and delivering projects with a strong focus on sustainable results
  • Applying agile methodologies: Using agile ways of working and taking on relevant roles (e.g. Scrum Master or Product Owner) within projects
  • Change management: Designing and supporting transformation processes, including stakeholder management and implementation support
  • Process analysis and optimization: Identifying improvement opportunities and developing as well as implementing efficient, digitally enabled processes
  • Management-level communication and reporting: Conducting structured analyses and preparing content tailored to decision-makers and steering committees


YOUR PROFIL

We are looking for people with drive, a strong sense of responsibility, and a clear affinity for technology and transformation.
What you should bring to the role:

  • A completed degree in (Business) Informatics, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field of study
  • Several years of professional experience (at least 3–5 years) in management consulting or in transformation/digitalization projects
  • Certification in agile project management, ideally as a Scrum Master or Product Owner, as well as hands-on experience applying agile methodologies
  • Strong technological understanding: Ability to translate modern technologies (Cloud, Data & AI, Cybersecurity) into scalable IT architectures and digital platforms
  • Project management expertise: Experience managing (sub-)projects, including planning, steering, and stakeholder communication
  • Experience in transformation and change management: Ability to support organizational change in a structured way and ensure sustainable implementation
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills combined with a pragmatic, solution-oriented working style
  • Excellent MS Office skills (especially PowerPoint and Excel), along with strong presentation and communication abilities
  • High level of initiative, strong teamwork skills, and a customer-oriented mindset
  • You have very good German and English language skills (minimum C1 level in both languages)


YOUR BENEFITS

  • Supportive Team Culture: Team cohesion is important to us - we support one another and foster a healthy office culture. Our event team organizes regular after-work events to encourage exchange and connection beyond the workplace.
  • Early Ownership & Responsibility: From day one, you will take on exciting tasks with real responsibility – whether on your project or by contributing to internal initiatives. You help shape the way we work.
  • Clear Career Development Paths: You will find an environment that supports, challenges, and advances your professional growth. We offer clearly defined career paths and a transparent competency framework for every level.
  • Creative Work Environment: We give you the freedom and time to develop creative solutions and provide the best, most modern hardware to support you (Apple or Windows).
  • Employee Benefits: Flexible working models, a BahnCard, JobRad, Spendit card, Wellpass, and a company pension scheme contribute to your well-being. In addition, you’ll enjoy the best coffee from our new espresso machine and a fully stocked soft drinks fridge in the office.
  • Attractive Vacation Policy: You benefit from 30 days of paid vacation per year and the flexibility to work from home.
